AccountId.description:
The identifier of the account this salary line should be posted on.
Sub-ledger accounts can also be referenced in this field.
If not set, the account from the pay item will be used.
If set, any account set on the pay item will be overridden for this given salary line.

Amount.description:
The amount of the salary line, in the client currency.
The relevance of setting amount depend on the pay item set.
For a pay item with a quantity and rate, the quantity and rate should be provided as drivers, and the system will calculate the amount.

CarListPrice.description:
The list price of the car, in the client currency.
Relevant only for pay items with free car/work car processing types, where the list price is required.

CarRegistrationDate.description:
The registration date of the car.
Relevant to set only for certain pay items with car/work car related processing types.

CarRegistrationNo.description:
The registration number of the car.
Relevant to set only for certain pay items with car/work car related processing types.

Cid.description:
The CID number (norwegian: KID), relevant if UseRemittance and SupplierBankAccountId is set.
Only relevant to set for pay items with the following processing types: TradeUnionDeduction and AttachmentOfEarnings.

Comment.description:
A comment to the salary line.
Will be shown on the employee payslip if set.

DepartmentId.description:
The department identifier.
Relevant to set if the salary line should be posted with a given department dimension.
If not set, the department will inherit the department set on the employee if/when the salary line is included in a payroll.

EmploymentId.description:
The identifier of the employment this salary line relates to.
Relevant if the employee has multiple employments.
If not set, the employee's default employment will be used.

FromDate.description:
The from-date.
Relevant to set only for certain pay items that have deduction processing types, and if the deduction is relevant only for a certain time period.

HomeWorkKilometers.description:
The number of kilometers driven between home and work.
Relevant only for pay items with the processing type FreeCarOutsideStandardRule.

IncomeYear.description:
The income year.
Relevant only for pay items with certain processing types, such as holiday pay.

IsActive.description:
Value indicating whether this (fixed) salary line should be included when creating a new payroll.
If true then this (fixed) salary line will be included in the payroll.
Defaults to true if not set.

IsCarPool.description:
Value indicating whether this his salary line relate to a car-pool or not.
Only relevant to set for pay items with the processing type FreeCarStandardRule or FreeCarOther.
With these two processing types, either car-pool or car registration number must be set.
Defaults to false if not set.

MaxAmount.description:
The maximum amount when calculating trade union deduction.
Relevant only for pay items with the processing type TradeUnionDeduction.

MemberNo.description:
The member number of the trade union or pension scheme.
Relevant only for pay items with the following processing types: TradeUnionDeduction, PensionDeduction or PensionDeductionUnlimited.

MinAmount.description:
The minimum amount when calculating trade union deduction.
Relevant only for pay items with the processing type TradeUnionDeduction.

Number.description:
The number field.
Only relevant for pay items with certain processing types that require an input of the number of times an event have occurred.
For example the number of journeys for a commuter, if the processing type is CommuterWithNumberOfJourneys.

OppositeAccountId.description:
The identifier of the opposite account this salary line should be posted on.
Sub-ledger accounts can also be referenced in this field.
If not set, the opposite account from the pay item will be used.
If set, any opposite account set on the pay item will be overridden for this given salary line.

PayItemId.description: The identifier of the pay item.

PrivateDrivenKilometers.description:
The number of kilometers driven with private use.
Relevant only for pay items with the processing type FreeCarOutsideStandardRule or WorkCarKilometers.

ProjectId.description:
The project identifier.
Relevant to set if the salary line should be posted with a given project dimension.

Quantity.description:
The quantity of the salary line.
The relevance of setting quantity and the interpretation of unit depend on the pay item set.
For a pay items defined with a quantity related processing types, the quantity should be provided as the driver.

Rate.description:
The rate of the salary line.
The relevance of setting rate depend on the pay item set.
For pay items defined with a variable rate, the rate should be provided as the driver.
For pay items with fixed rates, the rate is usually set on the pay item and will be overridden if set on a salary line.
Also note that hourly wage rates are usually calculated form the employment salary, and not needed to set on salary lines as the system automatically calculates the rate on the payroll.

StartAmount.description:
The start amount of the salary line deduction, in the client currency.
Relevant only for pay items with the following deduction processing types: DeductionWithBalance, AttachmentOfEarnings and AttachmentOfEarningsTax.
If not set on a salary line with a pay item of one of these processing types, the deduction will repeat until stopped.
If set, the deduction will run until the start amount is fully covered.

SupplierAccountId.description:
The identifier of the supplier sub-ledger account to post deductions.
Only relevant to set for pay items with the following processing types: TradeUnionDeduction and AttachmentOfEarnings.

SupplierBankAccountId.description:
The identifier of the supplier bank account.
Relevant only if UseRemittance is true, and for pay items with the following processing types: TradeUnionDeduction and AttachmentOfEarnings.

ToDate.description:
The to-date.
Relevant to set only for certain pay items that have deduction processing types, and if the deduction is relevant only for a certain time period.

UseRemittance.description:
Value indicating whether to use remittance or not.
Only relevant to set for pay items with the following processing types: TradeUnionDeduction and AttachmentOfEarnings.
Defaults to true if not set.

VatCodeId.description:
The VAT code identifier.
Relevant to set if the salary line is set with a pay item that have a processing type related to expense refund subject of VAT.

WorkDriveExceedsKilometerLimit.description:
Value indicating whether this his salary line relate to work drive that exceeds the kilometer limit or not.
Relevant only for pay items with the processing type FreeCarStandardRule.
Default to false if not set.

EmploymentType.description:
The type of employment.

Members:

  • Ordinary - Ordinary employment, i.e. employees working in the service of others for pay or other remuneration.
  • Maritime - Maritime employment, i.e. employees at sea, on vessels or mobile installations.
  • FreelancersEtc - Freelancers, board members, elected officials, trustees, foster parents, support contacts, respite care workers and carers.
  • PensionEtc - Pensions and other types of payment, without employment, coverage from the wage guarantee scheme and deceased debtors, persons participating in work training measures for the occupationally disabled when the pay is defined as the receipt of incentive payments (e.g. permanently adapted work), etc.

  • EmploymentRelationshipShouldNeverHaveBeenReported - The employment should never have been reported.
  • EmployerHasDismissedTheEmployee - The employer has terminated the employment relationship.
  • EmployeeHasResigned - The employee has resigned from his/her position.
  • ChangeOfPayrollSystemOrAccountant - Changed payroll system or accountant.
  • ChangeOfOrganizationStructureOrChangedJobInternally - Changes in organisational structure or internal job swap.
  • ContractCommitmentOrTemporaryEmploymentExpired - Contract, temporary appointment or temporary position has been terminated.

matrix) unless overridden on create/update.

ProjectId.description: The id of the project associated with this entry item, if any.

Quantity.description: The number of units recorded on this entry item.

Total.description:
The total amount for this entry item: billable quantity Ã— price with the entry's discount factor
applied, rounded to two decimals at each step. The discount comes from the product's discount matrix
as it applies to this entry's customer and project, so two entries on the same activity item can
total differently. Depending on the matching matrix rule the discount is either already included in
`price` (a fixed-price rule) or applied on top of it (a percentage rule); the factor itself is
not exposed.

EntryItemDto.description:
Read model for a time tracking entry item (domain `TimeTrackingEntry` whose activity has category
`Item`). An item entry records a quantity of units â€” not minutes â€” booked against an item activity.

ActivityItemId.description: The id of the item activity this entry item records units on.

BillableQuantity.description: The number of billable units for this entry item. Clear it to fall back to the calculated value.

CustomerId.description: The id of the customer associated with this entry item.

Date.description: The date of the entry item.

DepartmentId.description: The id of the department associated with this entry item.

EmployeeId.description: The id of the employee this entry item belongs to.

ExternalComment.description: An external comment about the entry item. May be visible to customers.

InternalComment.description: An internal comment about the entry item. Not visible to customers.

Price.description: Per-unit price override. Only honored when the activity item allows it (`PriceOverrideIsAllowed` = true); supplying a non-null price when it does not is a 400, while clearing the field is always allowed. A patch that does not mention this field leaves the price exactly as stored â€” changing `customerId` or `projectId` keeps this price (note that it still re-derives the entry's discount, so `total` can move). Clear it to fall back to the inherited/calculated price (the activity item's product price, less any discount that applies to the entry's customer/project); patching `activityItemId` to a different activity item likewise re-prices this entry from that item's product. Editing an activity item or its product never re-prices entry items that already exist.

ProjectId.description: The id of the project associated with this entry item.

Quantity.description: The number of units recorded on this entry item.

the mutable fields. `Id`, `Total`, `IsInvoiced`, `OutgoingInvoiceLineId` and

ActivityItemId.description:
The id of the item activity (see the ActivityItem endpoint) to record units on. Required (must exist,
else 404 â€” a time activity id reads as "not found"). The activity item must have a product.

BillableQuantity.description:
The number of billable units, overriding the calculated value. Only relevant for billable activity
items.

CustomerId.description:

EmployeeId.description: The id of the employee this entry item belongs to. Required (must exist, else 404).

requires an external comment.

InternalComment.description:
An internal comment about the entry item. Not visible to customers. Required when the activity item
requires an internal comment.

Price.description:
Per-unit price override for this entry item. Only honored when the referenced activity item allows it
(`PriceOverrideIsAllowed` = true); otherwise 400. When omitted, the price is inherited from the
activity item's product and its discount matrix.

ProjectId.description: The id of the project associated with this entry item (must exist, else 404).

Quantity.description:
The number of units recorded. Defaults to 1 when omitted. Must be greater than zero - a zero
quantity is rejected (400), because an entry item with no units, no comment and no billable

GeneralLedgerAccountType.description:
Members:

  • Asset - Represent the different types of economic resources owned or controlled by business, common examples of Asset accounts are cash, cash in bank, building, inventory, prepaid rent, goodwill, accounts receivable.
  • Liability - Represent the different types of economic obligations by a business, such as accounts payable, bank loan, bonds payable, accrued interest.
  • Equity - Represent the residual equity of a business (after deducting from Assets all the liabilities) including Retained Earnings and Appropriations.
  • Income - (Revenue) Represent the company's gross earnings and common examples include Sales, Service revenue and Interest Income.
  • Expense - Represent the company's expenditures to enable itself to operate. Common examples are electricity and water, rentals, depreciation, doubtful accounts, interest, insurance.

Amount.description:
The total gross amount for this import line. 
Positive lines will result in a debit entry and negative lines will result in a credit entry. 
The sum of Amount must be equal to 0 when ImportLines are grouped by document number and posting date. 
The Amount is generally in the client's local currency (the currency used on the general ledger). 
If both Amount and CurrencyAmount are provided, these values will override the internal exchange rate. 
If only Amount is provided and a CurrencyCode is specified (e.g., EUR), the exchange rate defined within PowerOffice Go will be applied. 
Note that when using Amount and a CurrencyCode other than the local currency (e.g., NOK), you must specify the value in the foreign currency within the Amount field.

CurrencyAmount.description:
The amount in the currency provided. 
Positive lines will result in a debit entry and negative lines will result in a credit entry. 
When both Amount and CurrencyAmount are provided, these values will override the internal exchange rate. 
Note that when using CurrencyAmount, you must also specify a CurrencyCode other than the local currency (e.g., NOK).

The currency code. 
Currency codes follow the ISO4217 standard.

This value can be put on sub ledger entries (importlines with CustomerNo, SupplierNo or EmployeeNo).

Take note that Customers in PowerOffice have a customer number field and a field for external number, used for referencing the number from external system. 
The system first looks for customer with an external code based on the number provided in this property, then looks for the regular customer number in PowerOffice.

Lines with this value set will be matched with other entries with same CustomMatchingReference after the import is complete.

CustomerNo.description:
The number of the customer ledger to post on (via the customer number). 
AccountNo will be ignored if both properties are provided. 
Take note that Customers in PowerOffice have a customer number field and a field for external number, used for referencing the number from external system. 
The system first looks for customer with an external code based on the number provided in this property, then looks for the regular customer number in PowerOffice.

DeliveryDate.description: The delivery date, relevant for outgoing (customer) invoice vouchers within imports of the type OutgoingInvoices.

DepartmentCode.description: The code of the department used as dimension on the accounting entry.

Description.description: The description of the import line.

Dim1Code.description: The code of the custom dimension 1 this importline is for.

Dim2Code.description: The code of the custom dimension 2 this importline is for.

Dim3Code.description: The code of the custom dimension 3 this importline is for.

DueDate.description: The due date, relevant for outgoing (customer) invoice vouchers within imports of the type OutgoingInvoices.

EmployeeNo.description:
The number of the employee to post on. 
AccountNo will be ignored if both properties are provided. 
Take note that Employees in PowerOffice have a employee number field and a field for external number, used for referencing the number from external system. 
The system first looks for employee with an external code based on the number provided in this property, then looks for the regular employee number in PowerOffice.

ImportedVoucherNo.description:
The imported voucher number.
All import lines with the same imported voucher number will be on the same voucher in PowerOffice Go.

InvoiceNo.description: The invoice number, relevant for outgoing (customer) invoice vouchers within imports of the type OutgoingInvoices.

LocationCode.description: The code of the location this importline is for.

PostingDate.description:
The posting date.
This is the date of effect in the accounting system for the Amount and CurrencyAmount.

ProjectCode.description:
The code of the project used as dimension on the accounting entry. 
Projects and subprojects are supported. 
Subprojects are set by providing the full project code including parent projects separated by dots (e.g. MainProjectCode.SubProjectCode).

PurchaseOrderNo.description: The purchase order number, relevant for outgoing (customer) invoice vouchers within imports of the type OutgoingInvoices.

Quantity.description: The quantity related to the product set on the importline, if used.

SaftBatchId.description:
Gets or sets the SAF-T batch ID. 
This is the ID of the batch in the system that transferred the voucher. 
Should be set if this voucher is a batch voucher containing the entries of multiple vouchers in the external system. 
When this voucher is exported to SAF-T, this property is transactions BatchID in the SAF-T file. 
The external systems SAF-T export should set the same BatchId on all the transactions that are included in this Voucher to ensure audit trail. 
Max length is 35 characters.

SaftSourceId.description:
Gets or sets the SAF-T source ID. 
This is the ID of the system that generated the voucher. 
When this voucher is exported to SAF-T, this property is mapped on the transactions SourceID in the SAF-T file. 
If the creating system is required to export its own SAF-T file, this source id should correspond with the SystemID in the SAF-T file of the external system to ensure an audit trail. 
Max length is 35 characters.

SupplierNo.description:
The number of the supplier ledger to post on (via the supplier number). 
AccountNo will be ignored if both properties are provided. 
Take note that Suppliers in PowerOffice have a supplier number field and a field for external number, used for referencing the number from external system. 
The system first looks for supplier with an external code based on the number provided in this property, then looks for the regular supplier number in PowerOffice.

ImportLinePostDto.description: The Import line post DTO contains properties relevant to creating (uploading) a new import object in Go.

Description.description: The description of the import.

ExternalImportReference.description:
The external import reference of the import.
This field is not available in the GUI, but can be used by the integrating party to reference the external system.
The field must be unique (on the given client).
Max length 50 characters.

ImportLines.description: The import lines to be imported.

ImportPostDto.description: The Import post DTO contains properties relevant to creating (uploading) a new import object in Go.

ImportStatus.description:
The import status.

Members:

  • Unknown - Status is unknown
  • Validating - Validating the import file
  • Uploaded - Import file has been uploaded and is waiting to be processed
  • Posting - Import is being processed
  • Posted - Import has been successfully processed
  • ValidationErrors - There is an error on one or more of the imported lines, eg. missing account, unknown project, etc. See ErrorMessage for details.
  • InvalidFileFormat - The entire import failed, eg. wrong file format for the selected import
  • ImportFailedRecoverable - The entire import failed but can be retried, eg. period is closed, cid is missing
  • Queued - The import has been queued and will be picked up and processed by a worker soon
  • DuplicateImport - The same file has already been imported, and can not be imported again

ImportType.description:
Members:

  • OutgoingInvoice - Import containing Outgoing vouchers (Invoice / Credit note) to customers
  • PayrollJournal - Import containing payroll journals
  • CashJournal - Import containing cash journals
  • YearEndJournal - Import containing year end journals
  • VoucherJournal - Import containing manual journals

Balance.description:
The balance of the supplier ledger entry this invoice is related to (remaining amount to be paid), in the client currency.
If balance is greater than totalPostedAmount, the entry will have a match in the supplier ledger with at least one other entry with the opposite amount, and those entries will share the same matchId. If the balance is zero, the invoice is considered paid in the GUI.

BalanceLastChangedDateTimeOffset.description:
The timestamp of the last change of the balance property.
This reflect the last changed timestamp of the supplier ledger entry this invoice relates to, and the match state of the sub-ledger entry.
Using this property as filtering is one way of retrieving the payment status of invoices.

Cid.description: The cid number (norwegian: KID), if present.

ContractNo.description: The contract number, if set on the invoice.

CreatedDateTimeOffset.description: The created timestamp of the invoice voucher.

CurrencyCode.description: The standard currency code for the invoice. Currencies active on the client can be queried using the AccountingSettings service. Currency codes follow the ISO4217 standard. Defaults to *NOK*.

CurrencyExchangeRate.description: The normalized currency exchange rate. Always base 1.

CustomMatchingReference.description: The custom matching reference, if set. This property will only have value on entries created through the API or Import with CustomMatchingReference specified. This property is used for matching purposes in the supplier subledger account, where entries posted with a CustomMatchingReference will be matched immediately with existing entries in the subledger that have the same CustomMatchingReference and opposite amount (unless existing entries are already matched out).

DepartmentCode.description: The code of the department for the invoice, if set. Note that this is the department set in the header of the invoice. The invoice costlines might specify other departments or no department.

DepartmentId.description: The id of the department, if departmentCode is set on the invoice.

Dim1Code.description: The code of the dimension 1 associated with the invoice, if set. Note that this is the dimension 1 set in the header of the invoice. The invoice costlines might specify other dimension 1 values or no dimension 1. Dimension 1-3 are customizable dimensions that can be defined and queried using the CustomDimension and CustomDimensionValue serivces.

Dim1Id.description: The id of the dimension 1 associated with the invoice, if dim1Code is set.

Dim2Code.description: The code of the dimension 2 associated with the invoice. Note that this is the dimension 2 set in the header of the invoice. The invoice costlines might specify other dimension 2 values or no dimension 2. Dimension 1-3 are customizable dimensions that can be defined and queried using the CustomDimension and CustomDimensionValue serivces.

Dim2Id.description: The id of the dimension 2 associated with the invoice, if dim2Code is set.

Dim3Code.description: The code of the dimension 3 associated with the invoice. Note that this is the dimension 3 set in the header of the invoice. The invoice costlines might specify other dimension 3 values or no dimension 3. Dimension 1-3 are customizable dimensions that can be defined and queried using the CustomDimension and CustomDimensionValue serivces.

Dim3Id.description: The id of the dimension 3 associated with the invoice, if dim3Code is set.

DueDate.description: The due date of the invoice.

ExternalImportReference.description:
The ExternalImportReference, if set. This property can be set by integrations posting vouchers to Go, in order to reference the external system and ensure a duplicate check (only one instance of the reference can exist for the object type).
Can be used to correlate/duplicate check transactions.
Max 50 characters.

Id.description: The identifier of the invoice and the posted voucher. The id is assigned by Go when the voucher is created, and is shared by all transactions within the same voucher (transactions have unique id's, but share the same property voucherId).

InvoiceNo.description: The invoice number of the invoice.

IsReversed.description: Gets a flag indicating whether the invoice voucher have been reversed. If true, the invoice voucher have been reversed with a reversal voucher (nullifying the invoice voucher), and the invoice number can be reused. Only possible to reverse an invoice voucher using the IncomingInvoiceVoucher api, and only by the integration that created the invoice voucher originally using this api.

LastChangedDateTimeOffset.description:
The timestamp of the last change of the invoice.
For posted invoices, no direct invoice information or related account transactions can change, so this property can be expected to be equal to the CreatedDateTimeOffset property.

LocationCode.description:
The code of the location dimension associated with the invoice.
Note that this is the location set in the header of the invoice. The invoice lines might specify other location values or no location.

LocationId.description: The id of the location dimension associated with the invoice.

MatchId.description: The match id of the supplier ledger entry this invoice relate to, if present. Available if the invoice have a match with other supplier ledger entries - typically payment transactions. Can be used with the SupplierLedger endpoint to retrive the matched transactions.

NetAmount.description: The net amount of the invoice (vat exclusive). This amount is presented in the currency used on the invoice (the currency given by the currencyCode).

NetPostedAmount.description: The net posted amount of the invoice (vat exclusive). This amount is always presented in the client currency (NOK). Will correspond with the netAmount and the normalized currencyExchangeRate.

ProjectCode.description:
The project code, if set on the invoice. Note that this is the project set in the header of the invoice. The invoice costlines might specify other projects or no project. Projects can be queried and identified using the Project service.
Max 50 characters.

ProjectId.description: The project id, if projectCode is set. Projects can be queried and identified using the Project service.

PurchaseOrderReference.description: The purchase order reference, if set. The property can be used to reference purchase order placed to the supplier.

RelatedInvoiceNo.description: The related invoice number. Can be available on supplier credit notes. If available, this property will reference the original invoice being credited.

SupplierId.description: The identifier of the supplier this invoice is related to.

SupplierNo.description: The supplier number for the supplier this invoice relates to. Suppliers can be queried and identified using the Supplier service.

TotalAmount.description: The total amount of the invoice (vat inclusive). This amount is presented in the currency used on the invoice (the currency given by the currencyCode).

TotalPostedAmount.description: The total posted amount of the invoice (vat inclusive). This amount is always presented in the client currency (NOK). Will correspond with the totalAmount and the normalized currencyExchangeRate.

VoucherDate.description: The date of the invoice voucher. This represents the date of the voucher and the document date of the invoice.

VoucherNo.description: The voucher number of the invoice voucher. This is the voucher number assigned by Go when the voucher was posted.  Voucher numbers are assigned by Go in sequence.  Always present on invoices.

IncomingInvoiceListItemDto.description: Represents an incoming invoice list item.

IncomingVoucherType.description:
Members:

  • IncomingInvoice - Incoming invoice sent from a supplier to the client.
  • IncomingCreditNote - Incoming credit note sent from a supplier to the client.

ApplicationKey.description:
The applicationkey, representing the integrated application that is to be onboarded on client(s).
Must be set in the POST call initiating the onboarding.

ClientOrganizationNo.description:
The organization number of the PowerOffice Go client that are to onboard the integrated application.
If set, only this client will be presented to the user that must authorize the integration.
If not set, the user will be presented a list of all clients the user have acccess to onboard, enabling onboarding of multiple clients in one process.

RedirectUri.description:
The redirect uri we will route to if the user successfully authorize onboarding on client(s).
The uri need to be whitelisted by the api team before use, and this must be done separately for the demo and production environments.
Note that the uri is allowed to be https://localhost in demo environment (does not need explicit whitelisting by api team).
The system validate the domain, sub-domain and path used, but any parameters beyond that are ignored (and as such, any "?to=" variants can be used as the integrating party see fit).

InitiateOnboardingPostDto.description: The initiate onboarding post DTO contains properties necessary for initiating the onboarding processes in GO.

TemporaryUrl.description: The temporary Url to be used in the process of user authentication and user authorization of onboarding the integrated application.

ValidUntilDateTimeOffset.description: The timestamp of when the temporary Url will expire.

InitiateOnboardingResponseDto.description: The initiate onboarding response DTO contains properties necessary for (continuing) the onboarding processes in external system.

InternationalIdType.description:
Members:

  • PassportNumber - Passport number
  • NationalIdentityNumber - National identity number (Social Security Number)
  • TaxIdentificationNumber - Tax identification number
  • ValueAddedTaxIdentificationNumber - Value added tax identification number

InternationalPaymentFeeDistribution.description:
Members:

  • Shared - The fees are shared between the sender and the receiver.
  • Sender - The sender pays all fees.
  • Receiver - The receiver pays all fees.

AccessRoleId.description: The access role id the user have on the client.

EmailAddress.description: The e-mail address of the user.

FirstName.description: The first name of the user.

FromDate.description:
From date, inclusive.
The user will have access to the client from this date.
If not set, the user will have access from the day the user accept the invitation.

InviteAsEmployee.description:
Indicates whether the user should be added as an employee on the client.
If true, an employee object will be created and linked to the user after the invitation is accepted.

LastName.description: The last name of the user.

ToDate.description:
To date, inclusive.
The user will have access to the client until and including this date.
Afterwards, the user is deactivated on the client.
If not set, the user will have no time restricted access.

InviteUserPostDto.description: The available properties when inviting users to Go.

InvoiceDeliveryType.description:
Members:

  • PdfByEmail - Invoice will be delivered as email with PDF as attachment. Can only be used if the customer have an e-mail address registered (either eMailAddress or invoiceEmailAddress).
  • Print - Invoice will be printed and delivered physically. "Sending" the invoice in Go will generate a PDF for download and print.
  • EHF - Invoice will be delivered over EHF. Can only be set if the customers organizationNumber is set and the number is registered in ELMA.
  • AvtaleGiro - Invoice will be delivered over AvtaleGiro. Cannot be set directly (set by the customer in an external process).
  • External - Invoice will be prepared for delivery over an external third party integration. Can only be set if the client have such an integration active.
  • Efaktura - Invoice will be delivered by Efaktura. Cannot be set directly (set by the customer on an external process).
  • Factoring - The invoice will be prepared for delivered over an external third party factoring integration. Can only be set if the client have such an integration active.

DueDate.description: The actual due date of the invoice or credit note.

Id.description: The identifier of a sales order, outgoing invoice or outgoing credit note.

InvoiceNo.description: The invoice number in number format. Available only for sent and posted invoices.

IsInvoiceBeingProcessed.description:
A flag indicating whether the send request was successfully queued.
Will be true while the invoice is in transit.
After the invoice is delivered to the customer, IsInvoiceBeingProcessed will be set to false.

LastErrorMessage.description: If invoice delivery fails this property will contain the last error message.
LastErrorMessage.example: ABC AS no longer support the receival of EHF invoice

SentDateTimeOffset.description:
The date this sales order was invoiced using Go. Will only be set if the order was successfully invoiced.
For integrations using the createAndSendInvoice request, this property having a value will confirm the delivery.
To retrieve any further invoice information, the OutgoingInvoices reporting endpoint should be used.

InvoiceSentStateDto.description: Represents the sent status of a sales order.

OptionalSalesAccountId.description:
The id of the sales account used for VAT-exempt sales on the client (shown as "Alternative Sales Account" in the UI). Relevant information when creating invoices from PowerOffice.
If not set on the product or product group level, the products will default inherit the client's VAT-exempt sales account.

StandardSalesAccountId.description:
The id of the standard sales account set on the client. Relevant information when creating invoices from PowerOffice.
If standard sales accounts are not set on the product or product group level, the products will default inherit the client's standard sales account.

InvoiceSettingsDto.description: The invoice settings on the client.

AccrualVoucherId.description:
The identifier of the accrual voucher this entry is accrued on, if accrued. Accrual of item transactions is a
functionality in the time tracking module in PowerOffice.

ActivityItemId.description:
The identifier of the associated item activity. Item activities can be retrieved using the item activities
endpoint.

ApprovalBatchId.description: The id of the approval batch this entry belongs to (if approved).

BillableAmount.description: The calculated accumulated billable value of this entry (billable rate * billable quantity * (1 - discount factor)).

BillableQuantity.description: Billable items, potentially overriding the calculated billable quantity.

BillableRate.description:
The billable rate per item for this entry. The rate is fetched from the associated product when the entry is
registered, and may be overridden on the entry itself.

CostPrice.description: The calculated accumulated cost of this entry (cost rate * quantity).

CostRate.description: The cost per item for this entry. The cost rate is fetched from the associated product.

CreatedDateTimeOffset.description: The timestamp when the item transaction was created.

CustomerId.description:
The identifier of the customer associated with the transaction.
Can be used directly against GET /Customers/{id}.

CustomerNo.description: The customer number of the customer associated with the transaction.

CustomerSubledgerAccountId.description:
The id of the customer subledger account associated with the transaction.
Note that this is the subledger account id, which is not the id used by the Customers endpoint.
Use CustomerId to look the customer up with GET /Customers/{id}.

Date.description: The date of the item transaction.

DepartmentId.description: The identifier of the associated department.

Dim1Id.description: The identifier of the custom dimension 1 associated with the transaction.

Dim2Id.description: The identifier of the custom dimension 2 associated with the transaction.

Dim3Id.description: The identifier of the custom dimension 3 associated with the transaction.

DiscountFactor.description: A discount factor between 0 and 1, related to the billable amount calculation.

EmployeeId.description:
The identifier of the employee this transaction relate to.
Can be used directly against GET /Employees/{employeeId}.

EmployeeNo.description: The employee number of the employee this transaction relate to.

EmployeePayrollSalaryLineId.description: The identifier of the employee payroll salary line this transaction relate to.

EmployeeSubledgerAccountId.description:
The identifier of the employee subledger account this transaction relate to.
Note that this is the subledger account id, which is not the id used by the Employees endpoint.
Use EmployeeId to look the employee up with GET /Employees/{employeeId}.

ExcludeFromBilling.description: Determines if this entry should be excluded from billing calculations.

ExcludeFromPayroll.description: Determines if this entry should be excluded from payroll calculations.

ExternalComment.description: A custom comment for the entry, visible externally (for example on invoices).

ExternalImportReference.description:
Used by external systems to match item entries (max 50 characters), and also act as a duplicate check
when creating new entries via api.

Id.description: The unique identifier of the item transaction.

InternalComment.description: An internal comment for the company.

InvoiceId.description:
The identifier of the invoice this entry was invoiced on.
Can be used directly against GET /OutgoingInvoices/{id}, which also returns the invoice number, and against
GET /OutgoingInvoices/{id}/Lines.

InvoiceLineId.description:
The identifier of the invoice line this entry is associated with. This is the same id as the one returned by
GET /OutgoingInvoices/{id}/Lines, which requires InvoiceId to be called.
Note that invoice lines do not correspond to sales order lines, since the lines are recreated when an order
is transformed into an invoice.

InvoicedExternallyReference.description: An invoice reference for externally invoiced entries.

IsAccrued.description: Indicates if the transaction has been accrued.

IsApproved.description: Indicates if the entry is approved.

IsDraft.description: Indicates if the entry is a draft.

IsIncludedInFixedPrice.description: Indicates if the entry is included in the fixed price of a Quality Assignment.

IsInvoiced.description: Indicates if the entry is invoiced with the billing workflow in PowerOffice.

IsInvoicedExternally.description:
Indicates if the item transaction is already invoiced externally. This property can be set in the user
interface or by api integrations posting item entries to PowerOffice.

IsInvoicedExternallyBy.description: The name of the integration that set IsInvoicedExternally to true.

IsRejected.description: Indicates if the approval of the entry is rejected.

IsSentToPayroll.description: Indicates if the entry is sent to payroll.

IsSubmittedForApproval.description: Indicates if the entry is submitted for approval.

LastChangedDateTimeOffset.description: The timestamp of the last change to the item transaction.

LocationId.description: The identifier of the associated location.

MainProjectId.description:
The identifier of the top-level project the transaction belongs to. Equals ProjectId when the
registered project is not a sub-project, otherwise the id of its parent project.

Margin.description: The calculated margin (billable amount - cost price).

OrderNo.description:
The order number of the sales order this entry was added to. Unlike SalesOrderId this value
remains populated after the order has been invoiced.

PayrollDescription.description: The description of the payroll this transaction is included in, if isSentToPayroll is true.

PayrollId.description: The identifier of the payroll this transaction is included in, if isSentToPayroll is true.

PayrollNo.description: The number of the payroll this transaction is included in, if isSentToPayroll is true.

ProductId.description:
The identifier of the product the item activity is linked to. The billable rate, cost rate and unit of measure
of the entry all originate from this product.
Can be used directly against GET /Products/{id}.

ProjectId.description:
The identifier of the project registered on the transaction. This is the project that was actually selected,
which may be a sub-project. When it differs from MainProjectId it is a sub-project of that
project. Group on MainProjectId to aggregate per main project.

QualityAgreementId.description: The id of the quality assignment related to the entry.

QualityDeliveryAreaId.description: The ID of the quality delivery area.

Quantity.description: The quantity of items registered on the entry (rounded to 4 decimal places).

SalesOrderId.description:
The identifier of the sales order this entry has been added to, if applicable.
Together with SalesOrderLineId it addresses GET /SalesOrders/{id}/Lines/{lineId}.
Once the order has been invoiced the sales order no longer exists as an order, and both this id and
SalesOrderLineId stop resolving through the SalesOrders endpoints. When
IsInvoiced is true, use InvoiceId / InvoiceLineId instead;
OrderNo remains available as a historical reference.

SalesOrderLineId.description:
The identifier of the sales order line this entry is associated with, if applicable. Only related to sales
orders. Requires SalesOrderId to be looked up, and is subject to the same invalidation on
invoicing described there.

UnitOfMeasure.description:
The unit of measure the quantity is expressed in, inherited from the associated product (the product's own
unit, else the unit of its product group). Units are predefined in PowerOffice and identified by their code,
which is the same value as the one returned by the item activities endpoint.

ItemTransactionDto.description: Represents an item transaction with all associated properties and relationships.

ItemTransactionOrigin.description:
Members:

  • Web - The item transaction was created via the web interface.
  • Mobile - The item transaction was created via the mobile app.
  • API - The item transaction was created via API.

CreatedDateTimeOffset.description: The timestamp of when the voucher object was created.

Id.description:
A value that uniquely identifies this voucher.
The Id is assigned by Go when the entry is created, and will persist when/if the voucher is posted.

InApprovalWorkflow.description:
Indicates whether the journal entry voucher is sent to approval and is in the approval workflow.
If true, the voucher cannot be deleted.

IsCreatedByCurrentIntegration.description: Indicates whether the querying integration created the journal entry voucher, in which case the value is true.

IsPosted.description:
Indicates whether the journal entry voucher is posted. If true, the voucher is posted an cannot be deleted via api or edited by a user in the GUI.
If false, the voucher is unposted.
If true, the voucher cannot be deleted.

LastChangedDateTimeOffset.description: The timestamp of the last change of voucher.

OriginatedFromEhf.description: Indicates whether the journal entry voucher was received by EHF. If true, the journal entry voucher have an EHF XML file.

JournalEntryVoucherListItem.description: Properties of journal entry vouchers list item.

LeaveType.description:
Members:

  • EducationalNonStatutory - Educational leave (Non-statutory).
  • EducationalStatutory - Educational leave (Statutory).
  • Maternity - Leave with parental benefits.
  • Military - Leave for military service.
  • OtherNonStatutory - Other non-statutory leaves.
  • OtherStatutory - Other statutory leaves.

Code.description: The code of the location.

CreatedDateTimeOffset.description: The timestamp of the created date of the location.

Id.description: The identifier of the location. This identifier is unique and assigned by PowerOffice Go when a new entity is saved, and should be provided when an entity should be edited or deleted (PATCH or DELETE).

IsActive.description: A value indicating whether this instance is active. Inactive locations disable the usage of that locations in the GUI. Defaults to false.

LastChangedDateTimeOffset.description: The timestamp of the last change of the location.

Name.description: The name of the location

Code.description: The code of the location.

IsActive.description: A value indicating whether this instance is active. Inactive locations disable the usage of that locations in the GUI. Defaults to false.

Name.description: The name of the location

Code.description: The code of the location.

IsActive.description: A value indicating whether this instance is active. Inactive locations disable the usage of that locations in the GUI. Defaults to false.

Name.description: The name of the location

ChangeReason.description: The reason provided for the change.
ChangeReason.example: Change triggered due to new law

LastChangedByUserId.description: The ID of the user who made the most recent change.

LastChangedDateTimeOffset.description: The timestamp of the most recent change.

LockDate.description: The lock date on the client. It's not possible to create accounting entries on this date or any previous date on this client.

LockDateSettingsDto.description: Represents the lock date settings of a client.

CurrencyCode.description:
The currency code of the voucher header.
The line amounts will default be determined in the currency specified in the header.
For some voucher types, different currency codes can be set on the line level, thus overriding the currency of the head.
Currencies active on the client can be queried using the AccountingSettings service. Currency codes follow the ISO4217 standard.

DepartmentId.description:
The department Id of the voucher header.
The lines will inherit the department from the voucher head if not specified on the lines.
Departments can be queried and identified using the Department service.

Description.description: The description field of the voucher header.

Dim1Id.description:
The id of the dimension 1 associated with the voucher header.
The lines will inherit the dim1 from the voucher head if not specified on the lines.

Dim2Id.description:
The id of the dimension 2 associated with the voucher header.
The lines will inherit the dim2 from the voucher head if not specified on the lines.

Dim3Id.description:
The id of the dimension 3 associated with the voucher header.
The lines will inherit the dim3 from the voucher head if not specified on the lines.

Id.description:
A value that uniquely identifies this voucher.
The Id is assigned by Go when the entry is created, and will persist when/if the voucher is posted.

LocationId.description:
The id of the location dimension associated with the voucher header.
The lines will inherit the location from the voucher head if not specified on the lines.

ManualVoucherLines.description: The lines of the manual voucher

Pages.description: A collection of voucher pages associated with this voucher.

ProjectId.description:
The id of the project associated with the voucher header.
The lines will inherit the project from the voucher head if not specified on the lines.

VoucherDate.description:
The voucher date.
This represents the date of the voucher, the document date of an invoice for instance,
and may differ from the transaction dates for lines the voucher, depending on the type of voucher.

ManualJournalEntryVoucherDto.description: Dto representing properties available on manual type voucher lines.

CreatedDateTimeOffset.description: The timestamp of when the line was created.

CreditAccountId.description: The id of the general ledger account or the subledger account to post the credit amount.

CreditVatId.description: The id of the vat code used for the credit entry.

CurrencyAmount.description:
The amount on the line, in the currency specified by the currency code of the voucher or the currency of the voucher line if available.
Gross amounts should be provided, along with the relevant vat code.

CurrencyCode.description:
The currency code of the voucher line. Will inherit the currency code of the voucher head if not set. The line amounts be determined in the currency specified on the line.
Currencies active on the client can be queried using the AccountingSettings service. Currency codes follow the ISO4217 standard.

CurrencyExchangeRate.description:
The normalized currency exchange rate. Always base 1. Relevant to set if the voucher line have a foreign currency with a specific currency exchange rate.
If not set, the field will inherit the rate in Go for the posting date set.

recommended, or other unique references. This property is only available using the api (not visible in the user
interface)

this voucher is a batch voucher containing the entries of multiple vouchers in the external system. When this
voucher is exported to SAF-T, this property is transactions BatchID in the SAF-T file. The external systems
SAF-T export should set the same BatchId on all the transactions that are included in this Voucher to ensure
audit trail. Max length 35 characters.

SAF-T, this property is mapped on the transactions SourceID in the SAF-T file. If the creating system is
required to export it's own SAF-T file, this source id should correspond with the SystemID in the SAF-T file of
the external system to ensure an audit trail. Max length is 35 characters.

The imported order number. Can be used to reference the order number in the external system. The imported order
number is visible on the invoice reports in the PowerOffice GUI.

ImportedVoucherNo.description:
The external voucher number. Can be used to reference the voucher number in the external system.
The external voucher number is visible in PowerOffice in various reports.

InvoiceNo.description: The invoice number of the outgoing voucher (invoice/credit note to a customer). Required property and must be unique for the client.

IsReversed.description:
Value indicating whether this voucher has been reversed. If an outgoing invoice voucher is reversed, the
invoiceNo and externalImportReference properties can be reused on a new voucher.

LocationId.description: The id of the location dimension associated with the voucher header and the customer sub-ledger transaction.

ProjectId.description: The id of the project associated with the voucher header and the customer sub-ledger.

PurchaseOrderReference.description: The purchase order reference. The property can be used to reference purchase orders placed by the customer.

QualityAssignmentId.description:
The quality assignment id associated with the voucher header and the customer sub-ledger transaction.
Can only be set to an assignment related to the customerAccountId set on the voucher.

SaftSourceId.description:
The SAF-T source id. This is the ID of the system that generated the voucher. When this voucher is exported to
SAF-T, this property is mapped on the transactions SourceID in the SAF-T file. If the creating system is
required to export its own SAF-T file, this source id should correspond with the SystemID in the SAF-T file of
the external system to ensure an audit trail. Max length is 35 characters.

SalesPersonEmployeeId.description: The (employee) id of the sales person associated with the outgoing voucher.

VoucherDate.description:
The voucher date.
This represents the date of the voucher, the document date of an invoice for instance,
and may differ from the transaction dates for lines the voucher, depending on the type of voucher.

VoucherLines.description: properties available in an outgoing credit note voucher line

VoucherNo.description:
The voucher number. This is the voucher number assigned by PowerOffice when the voucher was posted. Voucher
numbers are assigned in sequence.

OutgoingCreditNoteVoucherDto.description: Properties available in an outgoing credit note voucher

AccountId.description: The id of the general ledger account for the line.

CurrencyAmount.description: The amount on the line, in the currency specified by the currency code of the voucher.

DepartmentId.description: The department id of the line.

Description.description: The description of the line.

Dim1Id.description: The id of the dimension 1 associated with the line.

Dim2Id.description: The id of the dimension 2 associated with the line.

Dim3Id.description: The id of the dimension 3 associated with the line.

ExternalLineReference.description:
The external line reference associated with the line. This property can only be set using the api, in order
to reference the external system's line. Can be used to correlate/duplicate check transactions.

LocationId.description: The id of the location dimension associated with the line.

ProductId.description: The product id associated with the line.

ProjectId.description: The id of the project associated with the line.

QualityAssignmentId.description:
The quality assignment id associated with line.
Can only be set to an assignment related to the customerAccountId set on the voucher.

Quantity.description: The quantity dimension set on the line.

VatId.description: The id of the vat code used on the line.

to reference the external system's line. Can be used to correlate/duplicate check transactions.

LocationId.description: The id of the location dimension associated with the line.

ProductId.description: The product id associated with the line.

ProjectId.description: The id of the project associated with the line.

QualityAssignmentId.description:
The quality assignment id associated with line.
Can only be set to an assignment related to the customerAccountId set on the voucher.

Cid.description: The cid number (norwegian: KID), if applicable to the outgoing voucher.

ContractNo.description: The contract number reference of the outgoing voucher, if applicable.

CurrencyAmount.description:
The total amount of the outgoing voucher, in the currency specified by the currency code of the voucher.
This will be the amount posted in the customer sub-ledger of the provided customer of the voucher.
This amount must match the sum of the outgoing voucher line amounts.
For an invoice a positive amount is expected in this property, and for a credit note a negative amount is expected.

CurrencyCode.description:
The currency code of the voucher header.
The line amounts will default be determined in the currency specified in the header.
For some voucher types, different currency codes can be set on the line level, thus overriding the currency of the head.
Currencies active on the client can be queried using the AccountingSettings service. Currency codes follow the ISO4217 standard.

CurrencyExchangeRate.description:
The normalized currency exchange rate.
Always base 1. Relevant to set if the voucher have a foreign currency with a specific currency exchange rate.
If not set, the field will inherit the rate in Go for the voucher date set.
The rates in PowerOffice can be retrieved with the CurrencyRates endpoint.

CustomMatchingReference.description:
The custom matching reference of the customer sub-ledger transaction.
This property may be used for matching purposes on sub-ledger accounts,
where entries posted with a CustomMatchingReference will be matched immediately with existing entries in the sub-ledger that have the same CustomMatchingReference and opposite amount (unless existing entries are already matched out).

CustomerAccountId.description:
The id of the customer sub-ledger account.
This is a different identifier than the general customer identifier, and can be retrieved using the customer endpoint.

CustomerReference.description: The customer reference (i.e. buyers reference) of the outgoing voucher.

DeliveryAddress1.description: The primary delivery address as it was set when the outgoing voucher was delivered.

DeliveryAddress2.description: The secondary delivery address as it was set when the outgoing voucher was delivered.

DeliveryAddressCity.description: The delivery address city as it was set when the outgoing voucher was delivered.

DeliveryAddressCountryCode.description:
The delivery address country code as it was set when the outgoing voucher was delivered.
The code is ISO 3166-1 alfa-2 country code (Two characters)

DeliveryAddressZipCode.description: The delivery address zip code as it was set when the outgoing voucher was delivered.

DeliveryDate.description: The delivery date of the goods/services sold and related to the outgoing voucher.

DeliveryTermId.description: The id of the delivery term associated with the outgoing voucher.

DepartmentId.description: The department id of the voucher header and the customer sub-ledger transaction. Departments can be queried and identified using the Department service.

Description.description: The description field of the voucher header.

Dim1Id.description: The id of the dimension 1 associated with the voucher header and the customer sub-ledger transaction.

Dim2Id.description: The id of the dimension 2 associated with the voucher header and the customer sub-ledger transaction.

Dim3Id.description: The id of the dimension 3 associated with the voucher header and the customer sub-ledger transaction.

DueDate.description: The due date of the outgoing voucher.

ExternalImportReference.description:
The external import reference associated with the voucher.
This property can be set by integrations creating vouchers, in order to reference the external system and ensure
a duplicate check (only one instance of the reference can exist on the client). Can be used to correlate/duplicate
check transactions. Guid's are recommended, or other unique references. This property is only available using
the api (not visible in the user interface)

ImportedOrderNo.description:
The imported order number. Can be used to reference the order number in the external system. The imported order
number is visible on the invoice reports in the PowerOffice GUI.

ImportedVoucherNo.description:
The external voucher number. Can be used to reference the voucher number in the external system.
The external voucher number is visible in PowerOffice in various reports.

InvoiceNo.description: The invoice number of the outgoing voucher (invoice/credit note to a customer). Required property and must be unique for the client.

IsReversed.description:
Value indicating whether this voucher has been reversed. If an outgoing invoice voucher is reversed, the
invoiceNo and externalImportReference properties can be reused on a new voucher.

LocationId.description: The id of the location dimension associated with the voucher header and the customer sub-ledger transaction.

ProjectId.description: The id of the project associated with the voucher header and the customer sub-ledger.

PurchaseOrderReference.description: The purchase order reference. The property can be used to reference purchase orders placed by the customer.

QualityAssignmentId.description:
The quality assignment id associated with the voucher header and the customer sub-ledger transaction.
Can only be set to an assignment related to the customerAccountId set on the voucher.

SaftSourceId.description:
The SAF-T source id. This is the ID of the system that generated the voucher. When this voucher is exported to
SAF-T, this property is mapped on the transactions SourceID in the SAF-T file. If the creating system is
required to export its own SAF-T file, this source id should correspond with the SystemID in the SAF-T file of
the external system to ensure an audit trail. Max length is 35 characters.

SalesPersonEmployeeId.description: The (employee) id of the sales person associated with the outgoing voucher.

VoucherDate.description:
The voucher date.
This represents the date of the voucher, the document date of an invoice for instance,
and may differ from the transaction dates for lines the voucher, depending on the type of voucher.

OutgoingCreditNoteVoucherPostDto.description: Dto properties available in an outgoing credit note voucher

Balance.description:
The balance of the customer ledger entry this invoice is related to (remaining amount to be paid), in the client currency.
If balance is less than totalPostedAmount,
the entry will have a match in the customer ledger with at least one other entry with the opposite amount,
and those entries will share the same matchId.
If the balance is zero, the invoice will have the status paid in the GUI.

BalanceLastChangedDateTimeOffset.description:
The timestamp of the last change of the balance property.
This reflect the last changed timestamp of the customer ledger entry this invoice relate to, and the match state of the sub-ledger entry.
Using this property as filtering is one way of retrieving the payment status of invoices.

BrandingThemeCode.description:
The code of the branding theme used on the invoice.
Available if the invoice was created and sent from Go.
Branding themes can be retrieved using the SalesSettings endpoint.

BrandingThemeId.description:
The id of the branding theme, if brandingThemeCode is set on the invoice.
Branding themes can be retrieved using the SalesSettings endpoint.

Cid.description: The cid number (norwegian: KID), if present.

ContractNo.description: The contract number, if set on the invoice.

CreatedDateTimeOffset.description:
The created timestamp of the invoice object.
If the invoice was created and sent from Go, the created timestamp is the timestamp the order (invoice draft) was first created.
If imported, the created timestamp will represent the timestamp of the import.

CurrencyCode.description:
The standard currency code for the invoice.
Currencies active on the client can be queried using the AccountingSettings service.
Currency codes follow the ISO4217 standard.
Defaults to NOK.

CurrencyExchangeRate.description:
The normalized currency exchange rate.
Always base 1.

CustomMatchingReference.description:
The custom matching reference, if set.
This property will only have value on entries created through the API or Import with CustomMatchingReference specified.
This property is used for matching purposes in the customer sub-ledger account, where entries posted with a CustomMatchingReference will be matched immediately with existing entries in the sub-ledger that have the same CustomMatchingReference and opposite amount (unless existing entries are already matched out).

CustomerId.description:
The identifier of the customer this invoice is related to.
Customers can be queried and identified using the Customer service.

CustomerNo.description:
The customer number for the customer this invoice relates to.
Customers can be queried and identified using the Customer service.

CustomerReference.description:
The customer reference (ie buyers reference), if set.
This property is often used to give the receiver of the invoice a reference they are familiar with.
If CustomerReferenceContactPersonId has value, the name of the customers contact person is returned,
otherwise the "Your Reference" text used on the invoice will be returned.

CustomerReferenceContactPersonId.description:
The customer reference contact person id (ie buyers reference).
The default use of customer reference when invoicing from Go, is to reference a customer contact person.
If this property is set, the string property customerReference will have no value.
Contact persons can be retrieved using the ContactPerson endpoint.

DeliveryAddress1.description: The delivery address primary line as it was set when the invoice was delivered, if set and delivered from Go.

DeliveryAddress2.description: The delivery address secondary line as it was set when the invoice was delivered, if set and delivered from Go.

DeliveryAddressCity.description: The delivery address city as it was set when the invoice was delivered, if set and delivered from Go.

DeliveryAddressCountryCode.description:
The delivery address country code as it was set when the invoice was delivered, if set and delivered from Go.
The code is ISO 3166-1 alfa-2 country code (Two characters)

DeliveryAddressZipCode.description: The delivery address zip code as it was set when the invoice was delivered, if set and delivered from Go.

DeliveryDate.description: The delivery date set on the invoice.

DeliveryTerm.description:
The delivery term of the invoice.
The default set of delivery terms provided in Go are incoterms, but any custom string can be set.

DeliveryTermId.description: The id of the delivery term of the invoice.

DepartmentCode.description:
The code of the department for the invoice, if set.
Note that this is the department set in the header of the invoice.
The invoice lines might specify other departments or no department.
Departments can be queried and identified using the Department service.

DepartmentId.description:
The id of the department, if departmentCode is set on the invoice.
Departments can be queried and identified using the Department service.

Dim1Code.description:
The code of the dimension 1 associated with the invoice, if set.
Note that this is the dimension 1 set in the header of the invoice.
The invoice lines might specify other dimension 1 values or no dimension 1.
Dimension 1-3 are customizable dimensions that can be defined and queried using the CustomDimension and CustomDimensionValue services.

Dim1Id.description: The id of the dimension 1 associated with the invoice, if dim1Code is set.

Dim2Code.description:
The code of the dimension 2 associated with the invoice.
Note that this is the dimension 2 set in the header of the invoice.
The invoice lines might specify other dimension 2 values or no dimension 2.
Dimension 1-3 are customizable dimensions that can be defined and queried using the CustomDimension and CustomDimensionValue services.

Dim2Id.description: The id of the dimension 2 associated with the invoice, if dim2Code is set.

Dim3Code.description:
The code of the dimension 3 associated with the invoice.
Note that this is the dimension 3 set in the header of the invoice.
The invoice lines might specify other dimension 3 values or no dimension 3.
Dimension 1-3 are customizable dimensions that can be defined and queried using the CustomDimension and CustomDimensionValue services.

Dim3Id.description: The id of the dimension 3 associated with the invoice, if dim3Code is set.

DueDate.description: The due date of the invoice.

ExternalImportReference.description:
The ExternalImportReference, if set.
This property can be set by integrations posting vouchers to Go or creating invoice drafts, in order to reference the external system and ensure a duplicate check (only one instance of the reference can exist for the object type).
Can be used to correlate/duplicate check transactions.

Id.description:
The identifier of the invoice and the posted voucher.
The id is assigned by Go when the voucher is created, and is shared by all transactions within the same voucher.
If the invoice was first created in Go as a draft, the id is consistent from the outgoinginvoice draft, the sent invoice and the posted invoice voucher.

ImportedOrderNo.description:
The imported order number.
Can only be set on invoice drafts created using the api or import, and on vouchers posted directly using the api or an import.
Can be used to reference the order number in the external system.

InvoiceNo.description: The invoice number of the invoice.

IsCreatedByCurrentIntegration.description:
A value indicating whether the invoice is created by the integration currently communicating with the API.
Will be true for all entries that are created by the same integration user (same Application Key) as the integration currently authenticated.
Can be used in filtering if only the current integration's entries are relevant to report.
Note that invoices are considered created by an integration only if they are posted with the OutgoingInvoiceVoucher endpoint, or if the invoice was sent using the SalesOrders endpoint. If a sales order draft was posted/sent by a user in the GUI, it will be the user that posted/sent it that created the outgoing invoice.

IsReversed.description:
A value indicating whether this invoice voucher have been reversed.
If true, the invoice voucher have been reversed with a reversal voucher (nullifying the invoice voucher), and the invoice number can be reused.
Only possible to reverse an invoice voucher using the OutgoingInvoiceVoucher api, and only by the integration that created the invoice voucher originally using this api.

LastChangedDateTimeOffset.description:
The timestamp of the last change of the invoice.
On sent invoices, no direct invoice information or related account transactions can change, but last changed will trigger when the invoice is due, and when (if applicable) the next reminder stages for the invoice is triggered in the system.

LocationCode.description:
The code of the location dimension associated with the invoice.
Note that this is the location set in the header of the invoice. The invoice lines might specify other location values or no location.

LocationId.description: The id of the location dimension associated with the invoice.

MatchId.description:
The match id of the customer ledger entry this invoice relate to, if present.
Available if the invoice have a match with other customer ledger entries - typically payment transactions.
Can be used with the CustomerLedger endpoint to retrieve the matched transactions.

NetAmount.description:
The net amount of the invoice (vat exclusive).
This amount is presented in the currency used on the invoice (the currency given by the currencyCode).

NetPostedAmount.description:
The net posted amount of the invoice (vat exclusive).
This amount is always presented in the client currency (NOK).
Will correspond with the netAmount and the normalized currencyExchangeRate.

OrderDate.description:
The order date of the invoice.
OrderDate will default to the createdDate, but can be controlled and set in imports creating invoice drafts.

OrderNo.description:
The order number of the invoice.
Only present if the invoice originated from an invoice draft created in Go.
For invoice drafts created in Go, this value is autogenerated.

PaymentTerm.description:
The payment term of the invoice.
This is the number of days after an invoice is sent until it is due (days between the voucher date and the due date).

PaymentTermId.description: The id of the payment term of the invoice.

ProjectCode.description:
The project code, if set on the invoice.
Note that this is the project set in the header of the invoice.
The invoice lines might specify other projects or no project.
Projects can be queried and identified using the Project service.

ProjectId.description:
The project id, if projectCode is set.
Projects can be queried and identified using the Project service.

PurchaseOrderReference.description:
The purchase order reference, if set.
The property can be used to reference purchase order places by the customer.

RelatedInvoiceNo.description:
The related invoice number.
Can be available on credit notes, if the credit note is created and sent from Go.
If available, this property will reference the original invoice being credited.

SellersReferenceEmployeeId.description: The id of the employee set as the seller reference, if SellerReferenceEmployeeNo is set on the invoice.

SellersReferenceEmployeeNo.description:
The employee number of the reference to the seller, if set.
When a user view the invoice information in GUI, this property is referred to as our reference.

SentDateTimeOffset.description:
The timestamp of when the invoice was sent from Go.
Available only for invoice created and sent from Go.
Blank if the invoice was posted to Go using an import.

TotalAmount.description:
The total amount of the invoice (vat inclusive).
This amount is presented in the currency used on the invoice (the currency given by the currencyCode).

TotalPostedAmount.description:
The total posted amount of the invoice (vat inclusive).
This amount is always presented in the client currency (NOK).
Will correspond with the totalAmount and the normalized currencyExchangeRate.

VoucherDate.description:
The date of the invoice voucher.
This represents the date of the voucher and the document date of the invoice.

VoucherNo.description:
The voucher number of the invoice voucher.
This is the voucher number assigned by Go when the voucher was posted.
Voucher numbers are assigned by Go in sequence.
Always present on invoices.

AccountId.description: The general ledger account id this invoice line was posted to.

AccountNo.description: The general ledger account code this invoice line was posted to.

Allowance.description:
The percent of allowance/discount or allowance charge for this invoice line.
The value is between -1000 and 100 (reflects as -1000% or 100% in the GUI).
Negative percentage means the line is set with allowance charge.
Positive percentage means the line is set up with discount/allowance.

DepartmentCode.description: The code of the department this invoice line is associated with.

DepartmentId.description: The id of the department this invoice line is associated with.

Description.description: The description set on this invoice line.

Dim1Code.description: The code of the dimension 1 associated with this invoice line.

Dim1Id.description: The id of the dimension 1 associated with this invoice line.

Dim2Code.description: The code of the dimension 2 associated with this invoice line.

Dim2Id.description: The id of the dimension 2 associated with this invoice line.

Dim3Code.description: The code of the dimension 3 associated with this invoice line.

Dim3Id.description: The id of the dimension 3 associated with this invoice line.

ExternalImportReference.description:
The external import reference for this invoice line.
This property can be set by integrations posting vouchers in Go or creating sales orders (invoice drafts), in order to reference the external system's invoice line and ensure a duplicate check (only one instance of the reference can exist within each invoice object).
Can be used to correlate/duplicate check transaction.

Id.description:
The identifier of this invoice line.
The id is assigned by Go when the invoice is created.
Note that on the line level, the invoice lines do not correspond with the sales order lines, if the invoice was an sales order created in Go.
This is because the lines are recreated in the process of sending and posting the information when an order is transformed to an invoice.

IsAccrued.description: Value indicating whether the net posted amount was accrued over time when the invoice voucher was posted in Go. If true, the accrual transactions is best retrieved by getting the accounttransactions of invoice voucher.

LocationCode.description: The code of the location dimension associated with this invoice line.

LocationId.description: The id of the location dimension associated with this invoice line.

NetAmount.description:
The net amount of this invoice line (vat exclusive).
This amount is presented in the currency used on the invoice (the currency given by the currencyCode).

NetPostedAmount.description:
The net posted amount of this invoice line (vat exclusive).
This amount is always presented in the client currency (NOK).
Will correspond with the netAmount and the normalized currencyExchangeRate of the invoice.

ProductCode.description: The code of the product associated with this invoice line.

ProductId.description: The id of the product associated with this invoice line.

ProductUnitCost.description: The cost per unit of the product associated with this invoice line.

ProductUnitPrice.description: The sales price per unit of the product associated with this invoice line.

ProjectCode.description: The project code associated with this invoice line.

ProjectId.description: The project id associated with is invoice line.

Quantity.description: The quantity of this invoice line.

SellersReferenceEmployeeId.description: The id of the employee set as the seller reference.

SellersReferenceEmployeeNo.description: The number of the employee set as the seller reference.

SortOrder.description:
The sort order of the line.
Sort order start at 0.
The first line as viewed from the GUI, will have sortOrder = 0.

TotalAmount.description:
The total amount of this invoice line (VAT inclusive).
This amount is presented in the currency used on the invoice (the currency given by the currencyCode).

TotalPostedAmount.description:
The total posted amount of this invoice line (VAT inclusive).
This amount is always presented in the client currency (NOK).
Will correspond with the totalAmount and the normalized currencyExchangeRate.

VatAmount.description: The VAT amount of this invoice line.

VatCode.description:
The VAT code used on this invoice line.
Standard codes in Go is based on the SAF-T standard.

VatId.description: The VAT id for the VAT code used on this invoice line.

VatRate.description: The VAT rate for the VAT code used on this invoice line.

Cid.description: The cid number (norwegian: KID), if applicable to the outgoing voucher.

ContractNo.description: The contract number reference of the outgoing voucher, if applicable.

CreatedDateTimeOffset.description: The timestamp of when the voucher object was created..
