This property can be set by integrations posting vouchers in Go or creating sales orders (invoice drafts), in order to reference the external system's invoice line and ensure a duplicate check (only one instance of the reference can exist within each invoice object).
Can be used to correlate/duplicate check transaction.

LocationCode.description:
The code of the location dimension associated with the sales order line.
Will inherit location code from sales order head if not specifically set on the line.
Note that if LocationId is set as well in the request, LocationId takes precedence and LocationCode is ignored.
LocationCode = -1 means no location.

LocationId.description:
The id of the location dimension associated with the sales order line.
Will inherit location id from sales order head if not specifically set on the line.
Locations can be queried and identified using the Locations endpoint.
LocationId = -1 means no location.

ProductCode.description:
The code of the product associated with the sales order line.
The product object in Go contain information of sales account
(in effect which sales account number is used when the order is invoiced, and which vat code option that can be applied).
Please refer to our workflow description for more details.
Note that if ProductId is set as well in the request, ProductId takes precedence and ProductCode is ignored.

ProductId.description:
The id of the product associated with the sales order line.
The product-object in Go contain information of sales account
(in effect which sales account number is used when the order is invoiced, and which VAT code option that can be applied).
Products can be queried and identified using the Products endpoint.

ProductUnitCost.description:
The cost per unit of the product associated with the sales order line.
Will inherit (on creation) the unit cost set on the product object if not specifically set on the line.

ProductUnitPrice.description:
The sales price per unit of the product associated with the sales order line.
Will inherit (on creation) the sales price set on the product object if not specifically set on the line.

ProjectCode.description:
The code of the project associated with the sales order line.
Will inherit project code from sales order head if not specifically set on the line.
Note that if ProjectId is set as well in the request, ProjectId takes precedence and ProjectCode is ignored.
ProjectCode = -1 means no project.

ProjectId.description:
The id of the project associated with the sales order line.
Will inherit project id from sales order head if not specifically set on the line.
Projects can be queried and identified using the Projects endpoint.
ProjectId = -1 means no project.

Quantity.description:
The quantity for the sales order line.
Required to set if the line contain a product code.
NOTE Setting a negative quantity, will result in the line being interpreted as a creditation of the product quantity.
If the sum of the lines for the total sales order is negative, the sales order is considered a credit note draft.

SellersReferenceEmployeeId.description:
The id of the employee set as the seller reference for the sales order line.
Will inherit the seller reference from sales order head if not specifically set on the line.
Employees can be queried and identified using the Employees endpoint.

SellersReferenceEmployeeNo.description:
The number of the employee set as the seller reference for the sales order line.
Will inherit the seller reference from sales order head if not specifically set on the line.
Note that if SellersReferenceEmployeeId is set as well in the request, SellersReferenceEmployeeId takes precedence and SellersReferenceEmployeeNo is ignored.

SortOrder.description:
The sort order of the sales order line.
Sort order start at 0.
The first line as viewed from the GUI, will have sortOrder = 0.

UseStandardSalesAccount.description:
Whether the standard sales account of the product set on the sales order line is used.
             
If false, the optional sales account set on the product is used.
Query the product endpoint to retrieve the sales account information on the product.
                
If set to null, the standard sales account will be inherited from the customer account's VAT-free
setting. In other words, if the VAT-free setting is enabled, the StandardSalesAccount will be set to
false and the optional sales account set on the product is used.
            
The concept of sales accounts is also explained in the common workflow articles.

SalesOrderLinePostDto.description: The sales order line post DTO contains only properties relevant to a sales order line in Go that can be created via POST-method in API.

BrandingThemeId.description:
The id of the branding theme associated with the sales order.
If null in the header, the value may inherit from any project set on the sales order, or from the clients default branding theme.
Branding themes can be queried and identified using the Sales Settings endpoint.

ContactDeliveryAddressId.description:
The id of the contact delivery address associated with the sales order.
Contact delivery addresses can be queries and identified using the Contact Delivery Addresses endpoint.

CurrencyCode.description:
The standard currency code for the sales order.
Currencies active on the client can be queried using the AccountingSettings service.
Currency codes follow the ISO4217 standard.
Defaults to NOK, but may inherit the value set on the Customer entity if null.

CurrencyExchangeRate.description:
The normalized currency exchange rate.
Always base 1.

CustomMatchingReference.description:
The custom matching reference of the sales order.
This property will only have value on entries created through the API or Import with CustomMatchingReference specified.
This property is used for matching purposes in the customer sub-ledger account, where entries posted with a CustomMatchingReference will be matched immediately with existing entries in the sub-ledger that have the same CustomMatchingReference and opposite amount (unless existing entries are already matched out).

CustomerId.description:
The id of the customer associated with the sales order.
Customers can be queried and identified using the Customers endpoint.

CustomerReference.description:
The customer reference (ie buyers reference) of the sales order.
This property is often used to give the receiver of the (eventual) invoice a reference they are familiar with.
If CustomerReferenceContactPersonId has value, the name of the customers contact person is returned on get,
otherwise the "Your Reference" text used on the (eventual) invoice will be returned.

CustomerReferenceContactPersonId.description:
The id of the customer reference contact person (ie buyers reference) of the sales order.
If null, the value will be inherited from the project or the customer associated with the sales order.
If set, the contact persons name will be set as the CustomerReference on the sales order.
Contact persons can be queried and identified using the Contact person endpoint.

DeliveryDate.description:
The delivery date of the sales order.
Will default to the date when the sales order is sent (converted to invoice) if not set via import or api.

DeliveryTermId.description:
The id of the delivery term of the sales order.
If null, the value will be inherited from project, customer or the client delivery term settings.
Delivery terms can be queried and identified using the Delivery terms endpoint.

DepartmentId.description:
The id of the department associated with the sales order.
This is the department set in the header of the sales order.
If null in the header, the value may inherit from the project, customer or the employee creating the sales order (if created using the GUI) - in that order.
The sales order lines will inherit this value if no other department (or no department) is specified on the line.
DepartmentId = -1 means no department.
Departments can be queried and identified using the Departments endpoint.

Dim1Id.description:
The id of the dimension 1 associated with the sales order.
This is the dimension 1 set in the header of the sales order.
The sales order lines might specify other dimension 1 values or no dimension 1.
Dimension 1-3 are customizable dimensions that can be defined and queried using the Custom Dimensions endpoint.
Dim1Id = -1 means no dimension 1.

Dim2Id.description:
The id of the dimension 2 associated with the sales order.
This is the dimension 2 set in the header of the sales order.
The sales order lines might specify other dimension 2 values or no dimension 2.
Dimension 1-3 are customizable dimensions that can be defined and queried using the Custom Dimensions endpoint.
Dim2Id = -1 means no dimension 2.

Dim3Id.description:
The id of the dimension 3 associated with the sales order.
This is the dimension 3 set in the header of the sales order.
The sales order lines might specify other dimension 3 values or no dimension 3.
Dimension 1-3 are customizable dimensions that can be defined and queried using the Custom Dimensions endpoint.
Dim3Id = -1 means no dimension 3.

ExternalImportReference.description:
The ExternalImportReference associated with the sales order.
This property can be set by integrations creating sales orders, in order to reference the external system and ensure a duplicate check (only one instance of the reference can exist for the object type).
Can be used to correlate/duplicate check transactions.

ImportedOrderNo.description:
The imported order number.
Can only be set on sales orders created using the api or import, and on vouchers posted directly using the api or an import.
Can be used to reference the order number in the external system.
The imported order number is visible on the sales order in the Go GUI.

LocationId.description:
The id of the location dimension associated with the sales order.
This is the location set in the header of the sales order.
The sales order lines will inherit this value if no other location (or no location) is specified on the line.
Locations can be queried and identified using the Locations endpoint.
LocationId = -1 means no location.

PaymentTermId.description:
The id of the payment term of the sales order.
This is the default number of days after an invoice is sent until it is due.
If null, the value will be inherited from project, customer or the client payment term settings.
Payment terms can be queried and identified using the Payment terms endpoint.

ProjectId.description:
The id of the project associated with the sales order.
This is the project set in the header of the order.
The sales order lines will inherit this value if no other project (or no project) is specified on the line.
Projects can be queried and identified using the Projects endpoint.
ProjectId = -1 means no project.

PurchaseOrderReference.description:
The purchase order reference on the sales order.
The property can be used to reference purchase order places by the customer.

RelatedInvoiceNo.description:
The related invoice number.
Can only be set for sales orders that are credit note drafts.
If set, this property will reference the original invoice being credited.

SalesOrderDate.description:
The sales order date.
Will default to the date when the sales order is sent (converted to invoice) if not set via import or api.

SalesPersonEmployeeId.description:
The (employee) id of the sales person associated with the sales order.
If null, the sales person on the customer this sales order relates to is used or the default sales person from the SalesSettings.
Employees can be queried and identified using the Employees endpoint.

SalesOrderPatchDto.description: The sales order patch DTO contains only properties relevant to a sales order "head" part in Go that can be altered directly via PATCH-method in API.

SendInvoiceDeliveryType.description:
The available delivery types for the send request. Auto is set by default, if a delivery type is not provided in the request.

Members:

  • PdfByEmail - Invoice will be delivered to the e-mail address supplied in the send request.
  • PdfPrintForDownload - The invoice will be posted and a pdf generated, but take note that no actual delivery takes place to the end customer. The integrating party need to retrieve the pdf using the Blob endpoint, and ensure delivery of the invoice document to the end customer.
  • Auto - The system will automatically identify whether the end customer can receive invoices by EHF, eFaktura, AvtaleGiro (or in special cases Factoring or External delivery), and send electronically if possible. If not, the invoice will be delivered as pdf by e-mail, to the supplied e-mail address in the send request.
  • EHF - The invoice will be delivered over EHF with no fallback delivery method.
  • Efaktura - The invoice will be delivered over Efaktura with no fallback delivery method.
  • AvtaleGiro - The invoice will be delivered over AvtaleGiro with no fallback delivery method.

EmailAddress.description:
The e-mail address used for delivery by e-mail.
If not set in the request, the customers default invoice email address will be used.
Email address is required when using DeliveryType Auto or PdfByEmail.
Email address is not used for DeliveryType EHF, Efaktura or AvtaleGiro.

Id.description: The id of the sales order.

OverrideDueDate.description:
Override the due date of the invoice.
If not set, the due date will be determined by the payment term of the sales order.

VoucherDate.description:
The date the invoice voucher will get. If not provided, the voucher date will be set to the current date.
This represents the date of the voucher and the document date of the invoice (ie. the invoice date).

SendInvoiceRequestDto.description: Represents the status of a sales order.

The date the invoice voucher will get. If not provided, the voucher date will be set to the current date.
This represents the date of the voucher and the document date of the invoice (ie. the invoice date).

FromInclusive.description: The minimum number the subledger accounts in this series can have

GeneralLedgerAccountId.description: The underlying general ledger account ID of the subledger series.

GeneralLedgerAccountNo.description:
The underlying general ledger account code of this subledger series.
Subledger transactions in Go will be posted using the subledger number, but the overall accounting effect will be on this underlying account.
More information of accounts can be retrieved using the GeneralLedgerAccount service.

Id.description: The unique identifier of the subledger number series.

IsClientTrust.description:
The value indicating whether this number series is used by accounts that contain client trust funds.
Client trust accounts are accounts where realtors or lawyers, for instance, handles their clients' money.
Can be true if the client have the FinancialSettings.UseTrustAccountManagement set true.

IsDefault.description: The value indicating whether this instance is the default number series for that subledger numberSeriesType.

Name.description: The name of the subledger number series.

ToInclusive.description: The maximum number the subledger accounts in this series can have.

SubLedgerNumberSeriesDto.description: The subledger number series DTO contains all properties relevant to subledger number series.

SubLedgerNumberSeriesType.description:
Members:

  • Customer - The sub ledger number series contains Customer
  • Supplier - The sub ledger number series contains Supplier
  • Employee - The sub ledger number series contains Employee

SubjectToAuditType.description:
Members:

  • Yes - The customer is subject of audit
  • OptedOut - The customer may be subject of audit but have opted out
  • No - Customer is not subject of audit

The comment text should be human-readable. If necessary, use newline characters (\n) to format the text for better readability

Balance.description: The current total balance of the supplier, as of the date (inclusive) provided in the query.

SupplierAccountNo.description:
The supplier account number for the related balance.
SupplierAccountNo will also represent the Supplier number.
Suppliers can be queried and identified using the Supplier service.

SupplierExternalNo.description:
The external number of the supplier for the related balance, if set on the Supplier entity.
An external number set on the supplier is often used to reference the supplier number in the external system, if the supplier numbers are not kept in 1:1 sync between Go and the external system.
The field is available in the GUI with the name External Code.

SupplierId.description:
The identifier of the supplier this balance is related to.
Suppliers can be queried and identified using the Supplier service.

SupplierName.description:
The name of the supplier for the related balance.
Suppliers can be queried and identified using the Supplier service.

AppliesInvoiceId.description:

AppliesInvoiceNo.description:

The supplierAccountId must be the same as the supplierAccountId of the invoice that is being credited.

The line amounts will default be determined in the currency specified in the header.
For some voucher types, different currency codes can be set on the line level, thus overriding the currency of the head.
Currencies active on the client can be queried using the AccountingSettings service. Currency codes follow the ISO4217 standard.

CurrencyExchangeRate.description:
The normalized currency exchange rate.
Always base 1.
Relevant to set if the voucher have a foreign currency with a specific currency exchange rate.
If not set, the field will inherit the rate in Go for the voucher date set.
The rates in Go are retrieved from ECB via API.

CurrencyRegistryText.description: The currency registry text of the supplier invoice.

The department Id of the voucher header.
The lines will inherit the department from the voucher head if not specified on the lines.

The date of birth of the supplier.
 Relevant only if the supplier is a person (when isPerson is true).

EmailAddress.description:
The (general) e-mail address registered for the supplier.
This field is validated for typos in POST/PATCH calls.

ExternalImportReference.description:
The external import reference.
This field is not available in the GUI, but can be used by the integrating party to reference the external system.
The field must be unique within each class of Contacts (unique for customers, suppliers or employees).
Max length 50 characters.

ExternalNumber.description:
The external number.
This field can be used to reference the supplier number in the external system, if the supplier numbers are not kept in 1:1 sync between Go and the external system.
The field is available in the GUI with the name "External Code".
The field must be unique within each class of Contacts (unique for customers, suppliers or employees).
Note that in file imports to Go (including file imports using the ImportFile endpoint), this number has precedence over the supplier number.
I.e. when importing incoming invoices using a file, with the supplier number 20000 set in the file, the import will choose the supplier with ExternalNumber 20000 over the supplier with Number 20000. This is the case for file imports only.

FirstName.description:
The first name of the supplier.
 Relevant and required if the supplier is a person (i.e. isPerson is true)

Id.description:
The identifier of the contact.
This identifier is unique and assigned by PowerOffice Go when a new entity is saved, and should be provided when an entity should be edited (PATCH), deleted (DELETE) or retrieved specifically (GET).
The supplier object is a contact entity, meaning the id might be shared with a customer and/or an employee if the contact is registered as both a supplier and customer/employee in Go.

IsActive.description:
A value indicating whether this supplier instance is active.
This property reflects if a contact entity that was both a customer and a supplier, is currently active as a supplier.
Can be false in situations where the customer is still active so that the contact entity cannot be archived, but the supplier is deactivated by a user in the GUI.

IsArchived.description:
A value indicating whether this contact entity is/should be archived (set inactive)
Cannot be set if the contact have ledger balances (as either a customer or as a supplier).

IsPerson.description:
A value indicating whether this supplier is a person.
The setting apply to the contact entity, and is used to differentiate persons from companies.
If set true, the firstName and lastName should be set.
The default setting is false if not provided.

LastChangedDateTimeOffset.description:
The timestamp of the last change of the supplier.
Note that this property do not reflect changes in sub-entities (address, contact person etc) related to the contact.

LastName.description:
The last name of the supplier.
Relevant and required if the supplier is a person (i.e. isPerson is true)

LegalName.description:
The legal name of the supplier.
The legal name is the official registered name of the company, as opposed to the name which might be a marketing name.
Relevant only if the supplier is a company (i.e. isPerson is false)

Name.description:
The name of the supplier.
Relevant and required if the supplier is a company (i.e. isPerson is false)

Number.description:
The supplier number.
The number will also represent the supplier ledger account, used for supplier ledger transactions.
When creating new suppliers and setting the number (as opposed to letting Go assign the next available number if left blank), the number must be within range of the supplier ledger numberseries that exist on the client in Go.

OrganizationNumber.description:
The organization number of the supplier.
Relevant for suppliers that are companies (i.e. isPerson is false).

PaymentClientBankAccountId.description:
The identifier of the client bank account used for payments to this supplier.
Can be set and used in cases where different suppliers should be paid from different accounts.
If not set, the primary client bank account will be used.

PaymentTermSupplierId.description:
The identifier of the supplier payment term set as the default for this supplier.
Determines the due date (and any cash discount) suggested when posting vouchers for this supplier.
            
**EXPERIMENTAL:** This field is part of a new functionality in GO currently in pilot / closed testing phase.
It is marked as experimental and may change or be removed until the pilot / closed testing phase is completed.

Payout.description:
A flag indicating whether invoices or credit notes from this supplier should be paid using remittance.
Default true, and if true a remittance draft will be created when voucher are posted in the journal entry.

PhoneNumber.description: The phone number of the supplier.

ScanId.description:
The ID used to identify this supplier when scanning a PDF invoice or credit note.
If not set (null), the supplier's organization number is used for matching instead.
ScanId must consists of numbers only

SubledgerAccountId.description: The identifier of subledger account associated with the supplier.

SupplierCreatedDateTimeOffset.description:
The timestamp the contact first became a supplier.
For contacts being only suppliers, this property will be equal to the contactCreatedDateTimeOffset property.

WebsiteUrl.description: The url to the suppliers website.

SupplierDto.description: The supplier DTO contains all properties relevant to a supplier-object in Go

Cid.description: The cid number (norwegian: KID), if applicable to the voucher.

ClientBankAccountId.description:
The identifier of the client bank account used for payment/remittance.
Relevant if payout is true. If not set, either the payment bank account set on the supplier or the default client bank account will be used for any remittance.

ContractNo.description: The contract number of the supplier invoice.

CreatedDateTimeOffset.description: The timestamp of when the voucher object was created.

CurrencyAmount.description: The total amount of the supplier voucher, in the currency specified by the currency code of the voucher.

CurrencyCode.description:
The currency code of the voucher header.
The line amounts will default be determined in the currency specified in the header.
For some voucher types, different currency codes can be set on the line level, thus overriding the currency of the head.
Currencies active on the client can be queried using the AccountingSettings service. Currency codes follow the ISO4217 standard.

CurrencyExchangeRate.description:
The normalized currency exchange rate.
Always base 1.
Relevant to set if the voucher have a foreign currency with a specific currency exchange rate.
If not set, the field will inherit the rate in Go for the voucher date set.
The rates in Go are retrieved from ECB via API.

CurrencyRegistryText.description: The currency registry text of the supplier invoice.

DepartmentId.description:
The department Id of the voucher header.
The lines will inherit the department from the voucher head if not specified on the lines.
Departments can be queried and identified using the Department service.

Description.description: The description field of the voucher header.

Dim1Id.description:
The id of the dimension 1 associated with the voucher header.
The lines will inherit the dim1 from the voucher head if not specified on the lines.

Dim2Id.description:
The id of the dimension 2 associated with the voucher header.
The lines will inherit the dim2 from the voucher head if not specified on the lines.

Dim3Id.description:
The id of the dimension 3 associated with the voucher header.
The lines will inherit the dim3 from the voucher head if not specified on the lines.

DueDate.description:
The due date of the supplier invoice (i.e. when it is due paid).
Must be greater or equal to the voucher date.

Id.description:
A value that uniquely identifies this voucher.
The Id is assigned by Go when the entry is created, and will persist when/if the voucher is posted.

InvoiceNo.description: The invoice number of the supplier invoice.

LastChangedDateTimeOffset.description: The timestamp of when the voucher object was last changed.

LocationId.description:
The id of the location dimension associated with the voucher header.
The lines will inherit the location from the voucher head if not specified on the lines.

OriginatedFromEhf.description: Property indicating whether the journal entry voucher was received by EHF. If true, the journal entry voucher have an EHF XML file.

Pages.description: A collection of voucher pages associated with this voucher.

PaymentDate.description:
The suggested payment date if this voucher is to be subject of remittance.
Relevant if payout is set true.
If not set in POST or PATCH operations, the field will default to the due date of supplier invoices and the voucher date of supplier credit notes.
To remove any value from PaymentDate in PATCH, both PaymentDate and DueDate must be removed.

PaymentOnHold.description:
Property indicating whether the voucher remittance should be on hold.
Default false, and if true a remittance draft will be created when the voucher is posted, but with no payment date suggested - rather the state 'on hold'.

PaymentTermSupplierId.description:
The identifier of the supplier payment term applied to the invoice. Determines the payment terms (and any
cash discount) associated with the voucher. The due date is set independently via `dueDate`.
            
**EXPERIMENTAL:** This field is part of a new functionality in GO currently in pilot / closed testing phase.
It is marked as experimental and may change or be removed until the pilot / closed testing phase is completed.

Payout.description:
Property indicating whether the voucher should be paid using remittance.
Default true, and if true a remittance draft will be created when the voucher is posted.

ProjectId.description:
The id of the project associated with the voucher header.
The lines will inherit the project from the voucher head if not specified on the lines.

PurchaseOrderReference.description: The purchase order reference. The property can be used to reference purchase order placed to the supplier.

SupplierAccountId.description: The id of the supplier subledger account.

SupplierBankAccountId.description: The identifier of the supplier bank account associated with the voucher.

SupplierContactId.description: The contact ID of the supplier.

SupplierVoucherLines.description: The lines of the supplier invoice.

VoucherDate.description:
The voucher date.
This represents the date of the voucher, the document date of an invoice for instance,
and may differ from the transaction dates for lines the voucher, depending on the type of voucher.

SupplierInvoiceJournalEntryVoucherPostDt.description: Properties available for creating a journal entry supplier invoice.

Amount.description:
The posted amount of the entry. Amount is always presented in the client currency.
Always present on transactions.

Balance.description:
The balance of the entry (remaining amount to be paid), in the client currency on the date (openItems) / toDate (statement).
If balance is less than amount, the entry will have a match with at least one other entry with the opposite amount, and those entries will share the same matchId.

Cid.description:
The cid number (norwegian: KID), if present.
Entries with the opposite amounts and the same cid will be matched on the sub-ledger account, if the client use cid and the items are not already matched out.

CreatedDateTimeOffset.description:
The created timestamp.
This is the timestamp the transaction was created, and may differ from the timestamp of accounting effect for the transaction (ie the property PostingDate).
Always present on transactions.

CreatedFromImportJournalId.description:
The created from import journal identifier, if present.
Provided if this account transaction has been created in Go by an import.

CurrencyAmount.description: The currency amount. Differs from Amount if the transaction was posted with a currency other than the client currency.

CurrencyCode.description: The currency code. Currencies active on the client can be queried using the AccountingSettings service. Currency codes follow the ISO4217 standard.

CustomMatchingReference.description:
The custom matching reference set on the transaction. This property will only have value on entries created through the API or Import with CustomMatchingReference specified.
This property is used for matching purposes, where entries posted with a CustomMatchingReference will be matched immediately with existing entries in the sub-ledger that have the same CustomMatchingReference and opposite amount (unless existing entries are already matched out).

DepartmentCode.description:
The department code. Available if the transaction was posted with department.
Departments can be queried and identified using the Department service.

DepartmentId.description:
The department id. Available if the transaction was posted with department.
Departments can be queried and identified using the Department service.

Dim1Code.description:
The code of the dimension 1 associated with the entry.
Dimension 1-3 are customizable dimensions that can be defined and queried using the CustomDimension- and CustomDimensionValue-services.

Dim1Id.description: The id of the dimension 1 associated with the account transaction.

Dim2Code.description:
The code of the dimension 2 associated with the account transaction.
Dimension 1-3 are customizable dimensions that can be defined and queried using the CustomDimension- and CustomDimensionValue-services.

Dim2Id.description: The id of the dimension 2 associated with the account transaction.

Dim3Code.description:
The code of the dimension 3 associated with the account transaction.
Dimension 1-3 are customizable dimensions that can be defined and queried using the CustomDimension- and CustomDimensionValue-services.

Dim3Id.description: The id of the dimension 3 associated with the account transaction.

DueDate.description: The due date of the entry. Relevant only for voucher types IncomingInvoice and IncomingCreditNote. The date represent when the amount is due to be paid to the supplier.

ExternalImportReference.description:
The ExternalImportReference, if set.
This property can be set by integrations posting vouchers in Go, in order to reference the external system and ensure a duplicate check when posting the voucher to Go (only one instance of the reference can exist).
Can be used to correlate/duplicate check transaction.

Id.description:
A value that uniquely identifies this (ledger) entry. The Id is assigned by Go when the transactions is posted in Go.
Always present on transactions.

InvoiceNo.description:
The invoice number, if the entry is an entry with the voucher type IncomingInvoice or IncomingCreditNote.
Be aware that the invoiceNo is a string, so it's not necessarily a number.

IsCreatedByCurrentIntegration.description:
A value indicating whether this ledger entry is created by the integration currently communicating with the API.
Will be true for all entries that are created by the same integration user (same Application Key) as the integration currently authorized.
Can be used in filtering if only the current integration's entries are relevant to report (in simplified queries of payment status of invoices, for instance).

IsWriteOff.description:
A value indicating whether this entry was created by the write off functionality in Go.
Such entries are not payments, but an accounting routine writing off an open item.

LastChangedDateTimeOffset.description:
The timestamp of the last change of this entry.
The accounting entry in itself cannot change, but the match state of the sub-ledger entry might change.
Using last changed filtering is one way of retrieving new matched items and as such the payment status of invoices.

LocationCode.description: The code of the location dimension associated with the entry, if set.

LocationId.description: The id of the location dimension associated with the entry, if location code is set.

MatchId.description: The match identifier on the entry, if it is matched with one or more other entries. All sub-ledger entries that are matched together share the same matchId.

PostingDate.description:
The posting date.
This is the date of effect in the accounting system for the Amount and CurrencyAmount (also the currency conversion date used by Go if the currency rate was not set explicit when posted).
Always present on transactions.

ProjectCode.description:
The project code. Available if the transaction was posted with project.
Projects can be queried and identified using the Project service.

ProjectId.description:
The project id. Available if the transaction was posted with project.
Projects can be queried and identified using the Project service.

SupplierAccountNo.description:
The supplier account number this sub-ledger entry is posted on.
SupplierAccountNo will also represent the Supplier number.
Suppliers can be queried and identified using the Supplier service.

SupplierExternalNo.description:
The external number of the supplier of this sub-ledger entry.
An external number set on the supplier is often used to reference the supplier number in the external system, if the supplier numbers are not kept in 1:1 sync between Go and the external system.
The field is available in the GUI with the name External Code.
Suppliers can be queried and identified using the Supplier service.

SupplierId.description:
The id of the supplier of this sub-ledger entry.
Suppliers can be queried and identified using the Supplier service.

SupplierName.description:
The name of the supplier of this sub-ledger entry.
Suppliers can be queried and identified using the Supplier service.

VoucherDate.description:
The date of the voucher.
This represents the date of the voucher, the document date of an invoice for instance,
and may differ from the transaction dates for the voucher.
Always present on transactions.

VoucherId.description:
The voucher identifier.
The Id is assigned by Go when the voucher is created, and is shared by all transactions within the same voucher.
Always present on transactions.

VoucherNo.description:
The voucher number.
This is the voucher number assigned by Go when the voucher was posted.
Voucher numbers are assigned by Go in sequence.
Always present on transactions.

The field must be unique within each class of Contacts (unique for customers, suppliers or employees).
Max length 50 characters.

ExternalNumber.description:
The external number.
This field can be used to reference the supplier number in the external system, if the supplier numbers are not kept in 1:1 sync between Go and the external system.
The field is available in the GUI with the name "External Code".
The field must be unique within each class of Contacts (unique for customers, suppliers or employees).
Note that in file imports to Go (including file imports using the ImportFile endpoint), this number has precedence over the supplier number.
I.e. when importing incoming invoices using a file, with the supplier number 20000 set in the file, the import will choose the supplier with ExternalNumber 20000 over the supplier with Number 20000. This is the case for file imports only.

FirstName.description:
The first name of the supplier.
 Relevant and required if the supplier is a person (i.e. isPerson is true)

IsArchived.description:
A value indicating whether this contact entity is/should be archived (set inactive)
Cannot be set if the contact have ledger balances (as either a customer or as a supplier).

IsPerson.description:
A value indicating whether this supplier is a person.
The setting apply to the contact entity, and is used to differentiate persons from companies.
If set true, the firstName and lastName should be set.
The default setting is false if not provided.

LastName.description:
The last name of the supplier.
Relevant and required if the supplier is a person (i.e. isPerson is true)

LegalName.description:
The legal name of the supplier.
The legal name is the official registered name of the company, as opposed to the name which might be a marketing name.
Relevant only if the supplier is a company (i.e. isPerson is false)

Name.description:
The name of the supplier.
Relevant and required if the supplier is a company (i.e. isPerson is false)

Number.description:
The supplier number.
The number will also represent the supplier ledger account, used for supplier ledger transactions.
When creating new suppliers and setting the number (as opposed to letting Go assign the next available number if left blank), the number must be within range of the supplier ledger numberseries that exist on the client in Go.

OrganizationNumber.description:
The organization number of the supplier.
Relevant for suppliers that are companies (i.e. isPerson is false).

PaymentClientBankAccountId.description:
The identifier of the client bank account used for payments to this supplier.
Can be set and used in cases where different suppliers should be paid from different accounts.
If not set, the primary client bank account will be used.

PaymentTermSupplierId.description:
The identifier of the supplier payment term set as the default for this supplier.
Determines the due date (and any cash discount) suggested when posting vouchers for this supplier.
            
**EXPERIMENTAL:** This field is part of a new functionality in GO currently in pilot / closed testing phase.
It is marked as experimental and may change or be removed until the pilot / closed testing phase is completed.

Payout.description:
A flag indicating whether invoices or credit notes from this supplier should be paid using remittance.
Default true, and if true a remittance draft will be created when voucher are posted in the journal entry.

PhoneNumber.description: The phone number of the supplier.

ScanId.description:
The ID used to identify this supplier when scanning a PDF invoice or credit note.
If not set (null), the supplier's organization number is used for matching instead.
ScanId must consists of numbers only

SubLedgerNumberSeriesId.description:
The Id of the sub-ledger series this supplier belong in.
Relevant if the client have multiple supplier sub-ledger series, and if so highly relevant in POST calls if the integrating party does not set Number but lets Go assign the next available Number.
In such cases, Go will create the supplier in the default sub-ledger series, unless this property is set.

AccrualVoucherId.description:
The identifier of the accrual voucher this entry is accrued on, if accrued. Accrual of time transactions is a
functionality in the time tracking module in PowerOffice.

ActivityTimeId.description: The identifier of the associated time activity. Time tracking activities can be retrieved using the time activities endpoint.

ApprovalBatchId.description: The id of the approval batch this entry belongs to (if approved).

BillableAmount.description: The calculated accumulated billable value of this entry (billable rate * billable quantity * (1 - discount factor)).

BillableQuantity.description: Billable hours, potentially overriding the calculated billable quantity.

BillableRate.description: The billable rate per hour for this entry.

BreakDurationMinutes.description: Duration of break time registered on the entry.

CalculatedNormalWorkingDay.description: Calculated normal working day based on normal time and tracked minutes.

CostPrice.description: The calculated accumulated cost of this entry (cost rate * quantity).

CostRate.description:
The cost per hour for this time transaction. The primary source of the cost rate is set on the employee level and
time tracking settings of the employee. This rate has no direct relation to payroll and salary.

CreatedDateTimeOffset.description: The timestamp when the time transaction was created.

CustomerId.description:
The identifier of the customer associated with the transaction.
Can be used directly against GET /Customers/{id}.

CustomerNo.description: The customer number of the customer associated with the transaction.

CustomerSubledgerAccountId.description:
The id of the customer subledger account associated with the transaction.
Note that this is the subledger account id, which is not the id used by the Customers endpoint.
Use Web.ExternalApi2.Models.TimeTransactions.Dtos.TimeTransactionDto.CustomerId to look the customer up with GET /Customers/{id}.

Date.description: The date of the time tracking transaction.

DepartmentId.description: The identifier of the associated department.

Dim1Id.description: The identifier of the custom dimension 1 associated with the transaction.

Dim2Id.description: The identifier of the custom dimension 2 associated with the transaction.

Dim3Id.description: The identifier of the custom dimension 3 associated with the transaction.

DiscountFactor.description: A discount factor between 0 and 1, related to the billable amount calculation.

EmployeeId.description:
The identifier of the employee this transaction relate to.
Can be used directly against GET /Employees/{employeeId}.

EmployeeNo.description: The employee number of the employee this transaction relate to.

EmployeePayrollSalaryLineId.description: The identifier of the employee payroll salary line this transaction relate to.

EmployeeSubledgerAccountId.description:
The identifier of the employee subledger account this transaction relate to.
Note that this is the subledger account id, which is not the id used by the Employees endpoint.
Use Web.ExternalApi2.Models.TimeTransactions.Dtos.TimeTransactionDto.EmployeeId to look the employee up with GET /Employees/{employeeId}.

ExcludeFromBilling.description: Determines if this entry should be excluded from billing calculations.

ExcludeFromPayroll.description: Determines if this entry should be excluded from payroll calculations.

ExternalComment.description: A custom comment for the entry, visible externally (for example on invoices).

ExternalImportReference.description:
Used by external systems to match time tracking entries (max 50 characters), and also act as a duplicate check
when creating new entries via api.

FromTime.description: The start time of the time entry.

HourTypeDescription.description: The description of the hour type. Null/empty correspond with the default hour type in the system (ordinary time).

HourTypeId.description: The identifier of the hour type. Null/empty correspond with the default hour type in the system (ordinary time).

Id.description: The unique identifier of the time transaction.

InternalComment.description: An internal comment for the company.

InvoiceId.description:
The identifier of the invoice this entry was invoiced on.
Can be used directly against GET /OutgoingInvoices/{id}, which also returns the invoice number, and against
GET /OutgoingInvoices/{id}/Lines.

InvoiceLineId.description:
The identifier of the invoice line this entry is associated with. This is the same id as the one returned by
GET /OutgoingInvoices/{id}/Lines, which requires Web.ExternalApi2.Models.TimeTransactions.Dtos.TimeTransactionDto.InvoiceId to be called.
Note that invoice lines do not correspond to sales order lines, since the lines are recreated when an order
is transformed into an invoice.

InvoicedExternallyReference.description: An invoice reference for externally invoiced entries.

IsAccrued.description: Indicates if the transaction has been accrued.

IsApproved.description: Indicates if the entry is approved.

IsDraft.description: Indicates if the entry is a draft.

IsHolidayLeave.description: Indicates if this transaction originates from a holiday or leave registration.

IsIncludedInFixedPrice.description: Indicates if the entry is included in the fixed price of a Quality Assignment.

IsInvoiced.description: Indicates if the entry is invoiced with the billing workflow in PowerOffice.

IsInvoicedExternally.description:
Indicates if the time tracking is already invoiced externally. This property can be set in the user interface or
by api integrations posting time tracking entries to PowerOffice.

IsInvoicedExternallyBy.description: The name of the integration that set IsInvoicedExternally to true.

IsRejected.description: Indicates if the approval of the entry is rejected.

IsSentToPayroll.description: Indicates if the entry is sent to payroll.

IsSubmittedForApproval.description: Indicates if the entry is submitted for approval.

LastChangedDateTimeOffset.description: The timestamp of the last change to the time transaction.

LocationId.description: The identifier of the associated location.

MainProjectId.description:
The identifier of the top-level project the transaction belongs to. Equals Web.ExternalApi2.Models.TimeTransactions.Dtos.TimeTransactionDto.ProjectId when the
registered project is not a sub-project, otherwise the id of its parent project.

Margin.description: The calculated margin (billable amount - cost price).

OrderNo.description:
The order number of the sales order this entry was added to. Unlike Web.ExternalApi2.Models.TimeTransactions.Dtos.TimeTransactionDto.SalesOrderId this value
remains populated after the order has been invoiced.

PayrollDescription.description: The description of the payroll this transaction is included in, if isSentToPayroll is true.

PayrollId.description: The identifier of the payroll this transaction is included in, if isSentToPayroll is true.

PayrollNo.description: The number of the payroll this transaction is included in, if isSentToPayroll is true.

ProjectId.description:
The identifier of the project registered on the transaction. This is the project that was actually selected,
which may be a sub-project. When it differs from Web.ExternalApi2.Models.TimeTransactions.Dtos.TimeTransactionDto.MainProjectId it is a sub-project of that
project. Group on Web.ExternalApi2.Models.TimeTransactions.Dtos.TimeTransactionDto.MainProjectId to aggregate per main project.

QualityAgreementId.description: The id of the quality assignment related to the entry.

QualityDeliveryAreaId.description: The ID of the quality delivery area.

Quantity.description: The quantity of hours tracked (rounded to 4 decimal places).

SalesOrderId.description:
The identifier of the sales order this entry has been added to, if applicable.
Together with Web.ExternalApi2.Models.TimeTransactions.Dtos.TimeTransactionDto.SalesOrderLineId it addresses GET /SalesOrders/{id}/Lines/{lineId}.
Once the order has been invoiced the sales order no longer exists as an order, and both this id and
Web.ExternalApi2.Models.TimeTransactions.Dtos.TimeTransactionDto.SalesOrderLineId stop resolving through the SalesOrders endpoints. When
Web.ExternalApi2.Models.TimeTransactions.Dtos.TimeTransactionDto.IsInvoiced is true, use Web.ExternalApi2.Models.TimeTransactions.Dtos.TimeTransactionDto.InvoiceId / Web.ExternalApi2.Models.TimeTransactions.Dtos.TimeTransactionDto.InvoiceLineId instead;
Web.ExternalApi2.Models.TimeTransactions.Dtos.TimeTransactionDto.OrderNo remains available as a historical reference.

SalesOrderLineId.description:
The identifier of the sales order line this entry is associated with, if applicable. Only related to sales
orders. Requires Web.ExternalApi2.Models.TimeTransactions.Dtos.TimeTransactionDto.SalesOrderId to be looked up, and is subject to the same invalidation on
invoicing described there.

VatBasisRatio.description: The VAT basis ratio for a custom VatCode.

VatBasisRatioValidFrom.description: The from date for the VAT basis ratio.

VatBasisRatios.description: Custom VAT code basis ratios and valid from dates.

BaseVatCodeId.description: The standard vat id the custom vat code is based upon. Relevant only for custom vat codes.

Code.description:
The vat code. Go use standard SAF-T codes by default. Any custom codes, will have a notation with the letter C first.
Codes used specifically for vat compensation, are marked with the letter K first (relevant only if the client uses vat compensation, ie the VatSetting 'useVatCompensation' set true).

Description.description: The description of the vat code.

Id.description: The unique identifier of the vat code

IsActive.description: The value indicating whether this vat code is active

IsCustom.description: The value indicating whether this vat code is custom created. The code will have the letter C in the notation if true.

Name.description: the name of the vat code.

Rate.description: The rate of the vat code. This is a value between 0 and 1. 0 representing 0 % vat and 1 representing 100 % vat.

ValidFrom.description: The date this vat code is active from, inclusive.

ValidTo.description: The date this vat code expires. Inclusive.

VatBasisRatio.description:
The vat basis ratio. Relevant for custom codes in mixed vat conditions (Norwegian: Forholdsmessig fradrag MVA). This is a value between 0 and 1, with 0 representing 0% vat basis ratio and 1 representing 100% vat basis ratio.
Example: A net amount of 1000 NOK with 50% vat basis ratio and 25% vat rate, will have the vat amount calculated as: 1000 x 0.5 x 0.25 = 125 NOK

VatBasisRatioValidFrom.description:
The date this vat basis ratio is active from.
If no vat basis ratio is set, this date will default to the vat code valid from date.

Comment.description:
Comment associated with the approval status. We recommend that you provide a comment that reflects
the previous events in the external system and/or information that is relevant for the accounting
entries. The comment will be visible in the user interface in Go and added as a voucher history entry.
            
The comment text should be human-readable. If necessary, use newline characters (\n) to format the text for better readability.
Comment.example:
"External system feature:\n
                - Added project to lines. \n
                - Project code corrected in line 2.\n
                Approved in external system by:\n
                - Project Manager Espen Askeladd\n
                - Department Manager Ola Nordmann."

IsPosted.description: Property indicating whether the journal entry voucher is posted. If true, the voucher is posted an cannot be deleted via api or edited by a user in the GUI. If false, the voucher is unposted

VoucherId.description: A value that uniquely identifies the voucher. The Id is assigned by Go when the entry is created, and will persist when/if the voucher is posted.

VoucherLineType.description:
Members:

  • Normal - A normal (sales) line with a product and an account transaction
  • Text - A text line, no account transaction
  • Summary - A summary or subtotal line. Will summarize total hours from lines with the unit of measure type hours and/or total amounts, for the lines placed above this line. No account transaction
  • InvoiceFee - A line with the invoice fee, if invoice fee is used on this client. Will have an account transaction.
  • TotalHours - A summary line of the hours. Will summarize total hours from lines with the unit of measure type hours, for the lines that are placed above this line. No account transaction.

CreatedDateTimeOffset.description: The creation date and time of the voucher page.

Id.description: The identifier of the voucher page.

VoucherPage.description: Represents a page of a voucher.

VoucherState.description:
An enum that represents the state of a voucher.

Members:

  • IsDraft - The voucher is in a draft state, and can be edited, deleted or posted.
  • IsDeleted - The voucher is deleted.
  • IsPosted - The voucher is posted and cannot be edited or deleted.
  • IsProcessed - The voucher is in the process of being processed.

VoucherType.description:
Enum defining what kind of voucher the voucher is

Members:

  • Unknown - Unknown voucher type - Vouchers with a new voucher type not yet implemented in current version of the API will have this value. If this value appears, a new version of the API should be available and should be implemented.
  • IncomingInvoice - Incoming invoice sent from a supplier to the client.
  • IncomingCreditNote - Incoming credit note sent from a supplier to the client.
  • IncomingReminder - Incoming reminder sent from a supplier to the client.
  • OutgoingInvoice - Outgoing invoice sent from the client to a customer.
  • OutgoingCreditNote - Outgoing credit note sent from the client to a customer.
  • IncomingBankRemittance - Incoming bank remittance posting completed payments done by the client through a bank integration.
  • IncomingOcrGiro - Incoming OCR giro payments to the client paid with CID.
  • ManualJournal - Manual journal is a generic voucher type with various accounting entries without any specific kind.
  • Expense - Expense are expenses that have been paid by an Employee on behalf of the organization (Norwegian: Utlegg).
  • CashJournal - Cash journal contains accounting entries generated from a cash register.
  • YearEndJournal - Year end journal containing the various year-end accounting entries. (Norwegian: Ã…rsavslutningsbilag)
  • BankJournal - Bank journal containing transactions from the bank.
  • VatReturns - VAT returns are vouchers generated when reporting VAT.
  • PayrollJournal - Payroll journal are vouchers containing payroll transactions.
  • OutgoingPaymentReminder - Outgoing payment reminder containing fees and interest due to late payment of an outgoing invoice.
  • OutgoingNoticeOfDebtCollection - Outgoing notice of debt collection containing fees and interest due to late payment of an outgoing invoice.
  • OutgoingPaymentDemand - Outgoing payment demand containing fees and interest due to late payment of an outgoing invoice.
  • OutgoingWarrantOfExecution - Outgoing warrant of execution containing fees and interest due to late payment of an outgoing invoice.
  • CorrectionVoucher - Correction voucher generated to correct another wrongly posted voucher.
  • ReversalVoucher - A voucher to reverse a previously wrongly posted voucher.
  • DepreciationJournal - Depreciation journal generated when fixed assets are depreciated.
  • TravelExpense - Travel expense voucher to post a travel expense sent from an employee.
  • Settlement - Settlement after delivering various goods to a buyer, especially by agriculture businesses as an alternative to OutgoingInvoice. (Norwegian: Avregning)
  • NegativeSettlement - Negative settlement after delivering various goods to a buyer and the seller (this client) that is an reduction in accounts receivable. This can be either due to a correction of a previously delivered settlement, or that the supplier (this client) bought more then the goods delivered from the customer. (Norwegian: Negativ avregning)
  • SystemGeneratedDocumentationVoucher - Voucher generated by system to correct for missing vouchers.

CurrencyCode.description:
The currency code of the voucher header.
The line amounts will default be determined in the currency specified in the header.
For some voucher types, different currency codes can be set on the line level, thus overriding the currency of the head.
Currencies active on the client can be queried using the AccountingSettings service. Currency codes follow the ISO4217 standard.

Description.description: The description field of the voucher header.

The external import reference associated with the voucher. This property can be set by integrations creating
vouchers, in order to reference the external system and ensure a duplicate check (only one instance of the
reference can exist on the client). Can be used to correlate/duplicate check transactions. Guid's are
recommended, or other unique references. This property is only available using the api (not visible in the user
interface)

Id.description: A value that uniquely identifies this voucher. The Id is assigned by Go when the entry is created

ImportedVoucherNo.description:
The external voucher number. Can be used to reference the voucher number in the external system. The external
voucher number is visible in Go in various reports.

IsReversed.description: Value indicating whether this voucher has been reversed.

SaftBatchId.description:
The SAF-T batch id. This is the ID of the batch in the system that transferred the voucher. Should be set if
this voucher is a batch voucher containing the entries of multiple vouchers in the external system. When this
voucher is exported to SAF-T, this property is transactions BatchID in the SAF-T file. The external systems
SAF-T export should set the same BatchId on all the transactions that are included in this Voucher to ensure
audit trail. Max length 35 characters.

SaftSourceId.description:
The SAF-T source id. This is the ID of the system that generated the voucher. When this voucher is exported to
SAF-T, this property is mapped on the transactions SourceID in the SAF-T file. If the creating system is
required to export it's own SAF-T file, this source id should correspond with the SystemID in the SAF-T file of
the external system to ensure an audit trail. Max length is 35 characters.

and may differ from the transaction dates for lines the voucher, depending on the type of voucher.

already matched out).
